games.short_description: Rift Wizard 2 is a tough as nails traditional roguelike wizard simulator. You play as an immortal amnesiac wizard who must journey through the cosmos to defeat his nemesis. Each run, you'll build a unique repertoire of spells, passive skills, and magical artifacts.

games.name: Dobbel Dungeon
games.short_description: 集结队伍，掷出骰子，踏上穿越诸岛的激战之旅，将强大的诅咒彻底终结！尽在这款类 Rogue 回合制战棋 RPG！

games.name: Roll
games.short_description: Roll Dice. Get Dopamine. Roll is a highly replayable, deeply strategic, and ultra satisfying dicebuilding game!

games.name: Wanna Survive-活尸战棋
games.short_description: 「解残局」般的快节奏回合制战棋《Wanna Survive-活尸战棋》是一款末日活尸风格，强调布局走位深度策略，高难度的硬核回合制战棋游戏。

games.name: Siralim 2
games.short_description: Siralim 2 is an old-school monster catching RPG. Summon and customize hundreds of creatures to fight for you as you battle your way through endless dungeons. Find rare treasure and use it to upgrade your castle, empower your creatures, craft powerful artifacts, learn new spells, and much more.

games.name: 夺牌狂飙：序章
games.short_description: 卡牌游戏√；实时战斗√；搞笑段子√。如果这都不算你的梦中情游，那我就找不到别的了（顺便一提游戏中到处都是梗）

games.name: Morphblade
games.short_description: In Morphblade you move around a grid slicing, smashing and bursting waves of nasty red bugs. Each tile you move to transforms you into a different weapon: on a Blades hex you can slice enemies on either side of you, on an Arrow you can launch yourself through two enemies in a row.

games.name: Soulbind: Prologue
games.short_description: 灵魂束缚：序章》是一款 Roguelike 类型的动作平台游戏。主人公是一个平庸的骷髅，也是一个局外人。但有一个特殊功能--你可以用对手的身体部位替换自己的身体部位。了解背景故事，开始你的阿拉世界之旅吧。

games.name: 骰号玩家
games.short_description: 《骰号玩家》是一款以骰子为核心的roguelike策略游戏！你将一次次掷出手中的骰子，寻找能够改变局势的机会，运用智略将有限的机会变为无限的可能，突破艰难险阻，发掘出潜藏在阴影里的秘密……

games.name: Dungeon Scavenger
games.short_description: Dungeon Scavenger is a unique turn-based old school dungeon crawler that sets you on a challenging path of exploration. Select a hero to keep the threat of the dungeon and demon realms away from the town's people with an innovative combat system. Can you save the town from the danger below?

games.name: 蔷薇的夜宴2 蓝玉石
games.short_description: 《蔷薇的夜宴2 蓝玉石》是一款卡组构筑型roguelike游戏。化身主人公亚莉亚，想尽办法在魔物肆虐的学园中存活下来吧。

games.name: SYNTHETIK: Arena
games.short_description: SYNTHETIK: Arena 是一个快节奏的自上而下的射手设置在一个复古未来主义的世界, 结合了一个新的水平, 在枪玩与强大的技术实验。面对机器神的各种挑战 "Zir"。

games.name: NEO Scavenger
games.short_description: NEO Scavenger is a game where you must survive in the wasteland long enough to figure out who you are. Each turn, you must decide where to go, how to scavenge for supplies, and how to deal with anything and anyone you encounter.

games.name: Monsters' Den: Book of Dread
games.short_description: Enter the Monsters' Den, a place of endless adventure, battle and reward! Lead your party of four heroes through each level of the ever-changing dungeon, fighting in turn-based battles and hunting for that elusive rare loot. The web-game classic comes to Steam!

games.name: XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX
games.short_description: A paranoid cybercriminal tries to regain control over an underground marketplace stolen by his former coworkers. You must utilize your hacking and intelligence gathering skills to get rid of hitmen sent by your enemies in a race with worsening mental state and terrifying hallucinations.

games.name: 倒转方舟
games.short_description: 战棋+围棋元素+Roguelite=《倒转方舟》。 这是一款具有特色玩法的日式战棋游戏，除了应用普攻和技能卡牌将敌人击败，也能通过围住敌人的方式直接消灭敌人！ 玩家需在众多随机事件和能力分歧中做出抉择，想办法在末日的自相残杀游戏中存活下去….

games.name: The Witch's Cauldron
games.short_description: The Witch's Cauldron is a narrative roguelike game about being a medieval witch. Grab your cauldron and get brewing. Love, curses, laughter, wisdom for sale! Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. At least before the inquisitors come around.

games.name: TowerClimb
games.short_description: TowerClimb is a difficult and rewarding procedurally generated platformer with roguelike elements. Enormous and mysterious towers of ancient unknown origin stand above humanity, extending to the heavens. Struggle forward as a weak human, driven by an iron will to reach the top.

games.name: Oh, Bugger!
games.short_description: ‘Oh, Bugger!’ is a first-person shooter set in a luxury space hotel overrun by alien hordes. As a professional alien exterminator, pilot your mech to blast aliens and destroy their eggs, ending the infestation for good!

games.name: 灵动骑士
games.short_description: 《灵动骑士》是一款将被变成宝石的伙伴们聚集一堂，组合他们各自的能力活用于战斗的“组建小队”式地牢冒险游戏！ 在变幻莫测的地牢中探险，运用收集到的宝石挑战迷宫吧！

games.name: 通灵塔2
games.short_description: 通灵塔归来！现在它更棒了！使用强大的武器和咒语来击败蜂拥而至的敌人，在这个热门的RogueliteFPS中探索迷宫地牢，同时提高你的技能和发现新的装备。

games.name: 病毒识别：拯救系统
games.short_description: 在这被病毒深度感染的电脑操作系统中，成为桌面鼠标的终极化身！在这款爽快的动作肉鸽游戏中，穿梭于如地牢般的文件夹系统，荡清病毒，并通过EXE应用程序不断升级变强！

games.name: TYRONE vs COPS VR
games.short_description: Sip lean and shoot cops in this thought-provoking game on police brutality in America... Fully reimagined for VR!

games.name: 挂机神话
games.short_description: 挂爆电费，休闲摸鱼，偷懒耍滑！现代修真为皮；刷宝养成为骨；擦边玩梗为神。宅度与中二度突破天际，在游戏库内随时出击杀掉那些无聊的时间。其将为放置游戏中最妖艳的奇葩；其名为 挂 机 神 话 ！

games.name: Dungeon Dreams
games.short_description: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Customize your characters, take open-ended quests and write your own story in the town of Ecallia. A game with town building, dating and life sim elements, but also a randomly generated Dungeon with lots of companions and loot!

games.name: Cosmodread
games.short_description: Cosmodread是一款VR生存恐怖rogue类游戏，你需要从一艘处处暗藏噩梦的无人太空船中逃离。游荡在危机四伏的太空中，你必须探索、求生，并想办法安全返回地球。

games.name: 魔法迷域
games.short_description: 魔法迷域是卡牌构筑+Roguelike+战旗
dev: 武汉幻狮科技有限公司
pub: 武汉幻狮科技有限公司

games.name: 奇妙探险队2 Curious Expedition 2
games.short_description: 前往神秘的未知土地，展开勇敢的探险吧。名望、荣耀和财富在等着你！屡获殊荣的19世纪roguelike探险游戏现已推出续作，将为你带来富有新意的回合制探险体验、随机生成的游戏世界以及全新的剧情故事。

games.name: Tallowmere
games.short_description: 为了讨好Tallowmere小姐, 你能在她所钟爱的血腥地牢前进多远? 在这个2D横板独立Roguelike风平台游戏中你可以探索到什么? 每一次游玩时都会随机生成新的房间布局. 你究竟在其中前进多远呢?

games.name: Quantum Protocol
games.short_description: 这是一款牌组构筑卡牌游戏，但总是处于你的回合。扮演量子世界的黑客大师们，对抗世界上最危险的恶意软件，你的每一个动作都至关重要。玩游戏、升级卡组、摧毁对手！

games.name: The Monster Breeder
games.short_description: 基于回合制的奇幻角斗士游戏，带有怪物繁殖功能。将各种物种杂交，创造出用于角斗场战斗的怪物杂交体。用魔法和炼金术操纵幼年生物的特性。管理你的企业，制作物品和升级你的基地。在竞技场上为黄金和荣耀而战!

games.name: Fairyside
games.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike shoot-em-up with lots of bullet hell featuring cute pixel art, visual novel interludes, and story-driven gameplay. Join Shirley in her journey to learn magic and survive Redwood Academy!

games.name: 绿洲计划
games.short_description: 世界上本没有光, 只是有人替我们燃烧了自己.
pub: 上海翎迹网络科技有限公司

games.name: 杀戮台球
games.short_description: 在这款类 Rogue 地牢探险游戏中，你将化身一颗台球！在随机生成的关卡中，将怪物球推入袋口或陷阱。收集并叠加起无数会改变游戏玩法的物品，甚至可能破坏游戏的平衡。寻找物品组合，打造属于你自己的协同效应，定制你自己的游戏风格，开始这场杀戮台球吧！

games.name: Kill The Music
games.short_description: 跟随音乐节拍自动攻击，精准节奏踩点让你的伤害飙升！积攒独奏值，触发炫目动画与群攻效果，轻松扫荡敌群！

games.name: 星陨传说：流浪者的故事 Meteorfall: Krumit's Tale
games.short_description: 九宫网格加卡牌构筑的奇妙组合，“星陨传说宇宙”迎来了一部玩法全面升级的新作。 街角神秘魔法店，老人欲把往事谈。布鲁诺，灰胡子，英雄暮年已归乡，盖世巫妖早不见，《流浪者的故事》永流传。

games.name: Arcadium - Space Odyssey
games.short_description: Arcadium是一款生存类Roguelite游戏，背景设定在一个动态变化、充满未知的宇宙中。你将穿梭星际，采集星球资源，打造强力构筑，抵御一波波来袭的外星人。每一轮游戏都将带你进入一个全新、未曾探索的宇宙，带来无尽的挑战与发现。

games.name: Neophyte
games.short_description: A mini topdown action roguelike with chaotic spell-slinging hack-n-slash combat. Collect spells, choose perks and discover powerful synergies to become an unstoppable monster-slaying wizard.

games.name: 生块叉烧好过生你
games.short_description: 你将会扮演一块坏了的叉烧，在阴间展开一场无厘头超低能劲搞笑地地道道全配音地狱式非工业用无添加眼碌碌反高潮多重结局高清无码免运费无炭用䟴䟴脚经济实惠非主流已读不回坏肠胃超级无敌超过一百个Steam成就鬼咁多玩法的大冒险！ 这块叉烧最后能投个好胎吗？还是只能投个怪胎呢？全看你了~

games.name: Gacha Fever
games.short_description: Gacha Fever is a suvivors like in a cute and colorful universe. You will fight waves of monsters with various weapons, from the machine gun to the magical girl wand and the Bubble Tea Canon ! Just be careful of the area !

games.name: 沉默的蟋蟀
games.short_description: 《沉默的蟋蟀》是一款以斗蟋蟀为主题的“收集+养成”游戏。在一个叫做大夏国的地方，四季皆可斗蟋蟀，人人酷爱斗蟋蟀，斗蟋蟀是全民娱乐，更是最重要的产业之一。你可以去冲击天梯第一，也可以选择组建自己的蟋蟀战队去角逐全国联赛总冠军，更可以追求传说中的无双虫王！

games.name: Super Psycho Baseball
games.short_description: Welcome to Super Psycho Baseball, a sadistic home-run hitting roguelike in which you try to conquer a gang of pitch-slinging bosses, each more psychotic than the last. Come face five fully-realized pitchers, rack up powerups, and reach the top!

games.name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure Remastered Edition
games.short_description: Turn monster girls into your "Friends" and embark on an adventure together! This is a rogue-like game inspired by "Mystery Dungeon," where the terrain changes every time you challenge it.

games.name: Slay the Minotaur
games.short_description: Slay the Minotaur is a challenging roguelike dungeon crawler set in ancient Greece. Survive the onslaught of the labyrinth. Upgrade your skills, earn ranks, and face the Minotaur in the ultimate game of cat and mouse!

games.name: MORSE
games.short_description: Vanquish the Kaiser's Imperial Fleet using timing, tactics and telegraphy in MORSE, a minimalist strategy game that teaches you the secret language of Morse code. Can you change the world with the push of a button?

games.name: 汪!巫!录!
games.short_description: 《汪！巫！录！Dog Witch》是一款肉鸽卡牌游戏，通过魔法骰子施放咒语。组合150多种独特物品，打造演变策略与完美协同技，召唤随从，应对层出不穷的怪异敌人，让你难以置信、不由自主地摇尾巴！

games.name: Shape Shifter: Formations
games.short_description: Shape Shifter: Formations is an action twin-stick shooter with rogue-lite elements, where you must destroy hordes of geometric enemies alone or with a friend. Select your ship and combine a large variety of weapons, abilities and infinitely stacking upgrades to craft your own unique build.

games.name: Witching Stone
games.short_description: 《巫师石》是一款融合了牌库构筑机制的益智游戏！定制属于你的法术书，并运用五彩斑斓的巫师石编织各式各样的法术。

games.name: ADIOS Amigos: Galactic Explorers
games.short_description: Improvise fuel efficient trajectories to keep your rusty ship running. Break into a space station with an asteroid. Tow a sofa into a black hole. Experience the perils and intrigue of space exploration with 1-4 players.

games.name: Archvale
games.short_description: 在这个角色扮演游戏的子弹地狱世界里拿起你的武器，开始一段旅程来纠正很久以前就开始的错误。只有你才能打败不朽守护者的邪恶力量，让世界与传说中的Archvale重新统一。

games.name: The Enchanted Cave 2
games.short_description: 《魔法洞穴2》中文版正式上线！玩家将深入一个古怪的洞穴中进行探险，寻找源源不断的宝藏，打败不同的怪物，用技能把自己打造成不同的职业，让自己变得更强，走得更深，发现更多的秘密.....

games.name: Pigeons Attack
games.short_description: Pigeons Attack是一名自上而下的射手，其目标是尽可能长时间地保持鸽子群的生存。 使用放置在关卡附近的升级和武器。 解锁新角色，地图和魔法符文。 单独或与朋友一起帮助打击这种入侵！

games.name: Mage and Monsters - 法师与魔物
games.short_description: 组建一支大军，使用法术与他们并肩作战。《法师与魔物》是一款需要手动操作的自走棋游戏，在这款游戏中你必须谨慎选择，是提升军队的力量，还是增强法术的威力。

games.name: Doomsday Hunters
games.short_description: Shoot stuff in a perfect pixel world, combine items, build guns, die every time! Roguelite twin-stick shooter where magic and post-apocalyptic future technologies collide. Defeat evil lord Dracula and save everyone!

games.name: Starward Rogue
games.short_description: Starward Rogue is a bullet hell twin-stick shooter. Blast your way through the Megalith, a rogue-lite labyrinth lodged in the side of a star. Customize your mech with a huge variety of weapons, perks, and upgrades. Steel yourself for the dangers that lurk in the depths of the dungeon.

games.name: WazHack
games.short_description: Time moves forward only when you do in the dungeons of WazHack. Think your way out of problems instead of just spamming 'attack' and 'drink healing potion'.

games.name: 变量2
games.short_description: 沉淀了两年时间后，我们经过思考重新制作了变量的这款续作！ 变量2是一款独特的单机塔防游戏，我们丰富了塔防内的搭建和要素，并使游戏内的体验可以根据你的想法来进行变化！快一起来看看吧！

games.name: 别拽了！烤串师傅
games.short_description: 《别拽了！烤串师傅》是一款可爱又混乱的塔防Roguelike游戏。在游戏中化身烤串大师，随机抽食材、拼调料，凑出一支好吃又能打的串串小队，保卫你的烤炉！

games.name: Ruff Ghanor
games.short_description: Ruff Ghanor is a Deckbuilder game with Roguelite elements, where each collected card represents a crucial action in your journey. Build the perfect deck, strategize, and create powerful synergies as you progress to face your destiny.

games.name: Relapse
games.short_description: 这是一款Roguelike式的卡组构筑游戏。收集超240个不同的技能，通过升级和附魔对其进行强化，并将它们与上百个物品自由搭配，协同伙伴的特殊能力，创造出无数的组合来打败你的对手吧！

games.name: 超级代数大战 Super Algebrawl
games.short_description: 对自己的士兵进行加减乘除、克隆拆分，来打倒面对你的怪物们吧！

games.name: Monster Girl Manager
games.short_description: Summon, consult, and train procedurally generated monster girls in this dungeon roguelite. Evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of different monster types as you prepare the ultimate team to defeat dangerous enemies and collect powerful artifacts. (Game is SFW)

games.name: Switchcars
games.short_description: In a science experiment gone wrong, there's only one way to survive - traverse dynamic environments in over 1300 realistic vehicles, as fast as possible.

games.name: 活魔人
games.short_description: 在数不尽怪物进攻中活下来。解开谜题，进入远古的大教堂，彻底摧毁恶魔的源头。杀戮，升级，死亡。然后再战一次！

games.name: Grim Quest - Old School RPG
games.short_description: 融合地牢爬行、回合制战斗与Roguelike机制的黑暗奇幻RPG，配以手绘美术与深度文字叙事。兼具单人桌游战役与选择你的冒险的双重体验，无论是短暂探险还是通宵畅玩皆可尽兴。

games.name: 末日狂欢人外岛
games.short_description: 你能在末日降临前成功约会吗？《末日狂欢人外岛》是一款约会模拟RPG，融合了动态生成叙事和轻度卡牌战斗，游戏支持1-4人游玩。游戏以幽默搞怪的方式上演一场史无前例的恋爱狂欢。游戏共有130种不同结局和12位可追求的单身人士，保证每场约会都是全新体验！

games.name: Don't Die, Collect Loot
games.short_description: 是时候在这款街机 Roguelite 角色扮演游戏中变得无比强大，力量不受任何限制！引导你的英雄穿越无限的复古幻想世界，获得战利品，获得升级，并在终极力量幻想中撕裂成群的敌人时不断增强他们的力量！

games.name: 尼罗河勇士2
games.short_description: 《尼罗河勇士2》是一款快节奏的Roguelite战棋游戏，较之前作，今次的勇士们搭载了更具个人特色的作战方式，赋予游戏更丰富的玩法。自由决定冒险路线，选取技能石板强化角色，率领你的尼罗河勇士小队，击退来犯的罗马军团。

games.name: Ghost Signal: A Stellaris Game
games.short_description: Ghost Signal is a VR action roguelite set in the Stellaris universe, where you captain your ship to battle a multitude of alien species. Partake in dynamic space wars, encounter planet sized creatures, gather valuable loot to conduct research, and more. No journey is the same.

games.name: 无境空界
games.short_description: 《无境空界》是一款Roguelike自走棋卡牌游戏。招募不同的随从卡牌, 编排队伍, 见证它们迎战愈发强大的敌人。旅途艰险, 去邂逅诡秘的角色, 去领略异域的风光，去揭开那段深埋于一个失落王国之下的幽暗往昔。

games.name: 闇鍋人狼
games.short_description: Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry...

games.name: Thea: The Awakening
games.short_description: Thea: The Awakening 是一款回合制策略生存游戏，灵感源自斯拉夫神话，背景设定在一个程序生成的黑暗奇幻世界中，并融入非线性叙事与独特的战斗系统。

games.name: Zorbus
games.short_description: Zorbus is a fantasy-themed, tile-based, turn-based, traditional roguelike game.

games.name: Bardbarian
games.short_description: You play as Brad the barbarian, who is awoken to the sounds of his town under siege. Today is different though; Brad has grown tired of fighting all the time. The usual grind for XP has grown dull, and he has decided to pursue his dreams of making music instead of shedding blood.

games.name: My Slime Garden
games.short_description: Raise, nurture, and breed adorable slimes in a relaxing adventure where each slime is unique! Mix traits to create new slime companions and explore endless islands filled with secrets and surprises. Your perfect slime squad is waiting for you. How far can you take them?

games.name: Automon
games.short_description: Fast-paced auto-battler. Fight, capture and upgrade Automons, build a diverse party, battle bad Bosses and become the Automon Champion!

games.name: Tower Fortress
games.short_description: 一座神秘的高塔耸立云间！从塔顶散发出会让人生病的绿色毒雾。奇异的生物寄生在塔内。如果没有人能够顺利登顶，我们都将灭亡！ 你是那个英雄吗?.....

games.name: Dungeon Raid: Zero Floor
games.short_description: 《地牢突袭》是一款冒险卡牌Roguelike游戏。逐层深入地牢，击败敌人并挑战最终BOSS。祝你好运！切记不要死于饥饿……

games.name: Winter Falling: Battle Tactics
games.short_description: Lead troops in tense tactical battles, just you and your brain against the dying world. Can you save it? Manage a mercenary company, scavenge supplies, build an army. Go on a quest! Burn down a village or two... Explore the rich medieval fantasy world in a mix of LOTR, Warhammer, FTL and Total War.

games.name: Alluris
games.short_description: Prepare to embark on a journey like no other in Alluris. Play as a reluctant hero or villain to save the world… or just save a colony of bears from some lumberjacks. However you play, you’re sure to walk away with a few crazy stories about your adventure.

games.name: Gravebound
games.short_description: Survive as long as you can through the waves of magic guardians, level up to heighten your own magical abilities, and unlock game changing weapon upgrades and new arenas as you explore Dark Willow Crypt! Will you escape, or are you bound for the grave...

games.name: Dungeon Dreams 2
games.short_description: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Create your character and get a room at the Magic Academy dormitory, to win the Challenge of the Infinite Dungeon! A game with town building, relationships, and many quests with alternate routes.

games.name: 孤羊战纪
games.short_description: 《孤羊战纪》是一款像素风横版动作Roguelite游戏。通过流畅的像素动画结合技能连击的玩法，带来丰富而爽快的游戏体验！你将化身为一只手持科幻巨剑的小羊，为自己定制技能，发展出专属于你的独特战斗风格，在这个科幻末世的荒芜世界中，英勇的面对狼群的挑战吧！

games.name: 場外人生
games.short_description: 一個孤單的人，培養自我，增進事業，買房築巢，尋找伴侶，結婚生子，擴張勢力，建立國家，最終橫跨星海，啟動時光機器......，所謂幽默而真實的沙盒人生模擬器(つд⊂)。

games.name: Dead Signal
games.short_description: Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.

games.name: Elewar: Fused Survivors
games.short_description: 充满挑战性事件、深度ARPG系统和硬核难度！在这个子弹天堂类roguelite游戏中，你将使用元素力量击败可怕的怪物，努力成为拥有神一般力量的魔法师。25+个法术，300+个解锁项，120个升级，30多个随机事件，还有更多精彩内容！

games.name: 机兵大乱战
games.short_description: 《机兵大乱战》是一款Roguelite动作游戏，你将操纵人型仿生机器人“动力兵”，以及超重型“机甲”，横扫如潮水般涌来的敌人。随着不断游玩将会变得越来越强大的动力兵和机甲，均可随你定制。享受将大量敌人华丽地一扫而空的乐趣吧。

games.name: Eldritch
games.short_description: Eldritch is the original imsim roguelike: a first-person action game inspired by roguelikes, immersive sims, and H. P. Lovecraft.

games.name: Bloody Rally Show
games.short_description: Bloody Rally Show是一种反乌托邦的流氓战斗赛车游戏，拥有无限多样的赛道、活动、任务、排行榜、每日挑战、赛道编辑器、汽车编辑器、汽车编辑器、汽车改装、自定义、汽车战斗，以及多种游戏模式，其中包括一个你是行人的游戏模式。

games.name: Wantless : Solace at World’s End
games.short_description: In this dystopic sci-fi Tactical RPG, save your patients from themselves. Craft your skills among millions of combinations, heal the mind and face ever growing nightmares in 10mn runs. Will you overcome the insidious being chasing you across minds?

games.name: 迷走:二律背反
games.short_description: 只要左右滑动，就能做出各种选择，那么，请在亚斯特大陆中探索，谱写出只属于你的冒险谭吧!

games.name: 发糖模拟器
games.short_description: 《发糖模拟器》是一款克苏鲁题材的轮盘赌卡组构筑游戏。使用轮盘上的卡槽来设置卡牌，使卡牌发挥最大价值。你将收集克苏鲁神话中邪恶的生物，法术，道具以及场所来组成自己的卡组。你的最终使命是献祭由卡牌产出的贡品，解开封印使邪神降临人间。

games.name: Dark Bestiary
games.short_description: 黑暗兽集是一个有RPG元素的回合制战略游戏。和其他的RPG游戏有所不同的是，本游戏的核心并不是深刻的故事，反而是持续而激动人心的战斗。所以，你将会有机会探索异常丰富的战斗系统，挖掘你角色真正的潜力。

games.name: Dredgers - 沉没的王国
games.short_description: 目前可以使用超过30个'已知'种族,不同职业超过40种,且它并不像普通RPG游戏那样单纯线性的剧情和技能树,有的剧情和职业可能需要你开动脑筋才能发现他们,聪明的太阳骑士?敲打神秘造物的'巨匠'?或者是让矮人牧师学习战士技能并用弓箭射爆敌人。总之,这片神奇的地方里,有你一直寻找的‘宝藏’——快乐。

games.name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2
games.short_description: This is a "Mysterious Dungeon" style roguelike game where the terrain changes with each challenge. Make the monsters your "Friends" and go on a new adventure!

games.name: Let Them Come: Onslaught
games.short_description: 在科幻生存类 Roguelite 游戏《Let Them Come: Onslaught》中，幸存于外星部落的无情攻势。追求完美的构筑和不断扩张的技能武库，是你取得成功的关键。

games.name: Slipstream: Rogue Space
games.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike about teamwork, survival...and cute animals in space! Play with a few friends or join a streamer's crew of dozens as you work together to battle aliens across the vast Rogue Space.

games.name: Conquest of Elysium 4
games.short_description: Conquest of Elysium 4 is a quick turn based fantasy strategy game with a touch of rogue-like. The game is full of depth, details and monsters. There are also a huge number of factions, each with its own unique gameplay and magic rituals.

games.name: 大家的幻想乡·S
games.short_description: 《大家的幻想乡单机版》是一款卡牌对战养成游戏。 玩家扮演博丽神神社的新助手，帮助博丽神社获得信仰，以维持博丽神社正常运行。 玩家需要尽量完成各种委托，与幻想乡的各方势力搞好关系，以应对随时都可能发生的异变。

games.name: I wanna be The Cat
games.short_description: I wanna be the Cat is a challenging roguelite platformer inspired by I wanna be the Guy fangames.Fight against famous videogame characters turned into cats and try to claim "THE CAT" as the ultimate title.

games.name: 寻剑迷途 Lost For Swords
games.short_description: 《寻剑迷途》是一款Roguelite爬塔卡牌游戏。层层高塔均由卡牌构成，卡组中的每张牌都将影响房间格局。来捡起散落在地的一次性利器护甲、卷轴药水，征服这个世界中的所有怪物，还有发牌员！

games.name: 焕然异星：序章
games.short_description: 《焕然异星：序章》是《焕然异星》的免费独立版本，在序章中玩家需要面临诸多挑战，在这颗红色星球上建立第人类的第一个殖民地。

games.name: 节拍冲击
games.short_description: 与头目作战，解锁大量物品，尝试逃离MIDI宇宙。这是充满病毒的技术次元，音乐在这里化为了强大力量。MIDI宇宙充满了各种能力，组合起来可产生数百种不同的游戏风格。这一切的核心是你的歌曲；一个可以随时调整的循环节拍，可完全改变游戏的节奏。每次游戏都不同，背景音乐也不尽相同……这一切都由你来创造。

games.name: Gah! 哀叹地牢
games.short_description: 穿越程序生成的关卡——从阴森的地牢到未来感十足的太空站。选择13位独特角色之一，粉碎敌人、收集战利品、挑战致命的首领，并回到不断成长的村庄中心，解锁永久升级。恶魔注视着。天使等待着。而你，要战斗。

games.name: 阿尔法联盟HD
games.short_description: 阿尔法联盟HD是一款免费的单英雄自走棋游戏。不需要记住复杂的羁绊关系与装备配方，只需要选择你最喜欢的英雄，以肉鸽的方式搭配12种各有特色的战斗流派，在极具特色的场景中与其他7名玩家或机器人对战来获得胜利。

games.name: 几何竞技场2
games.short_description: 《几何竞技场2》是一款融合了RPG与Roguelite要素的动作射击游戏，主打 [ 局外构筑 + 无限冲层 ] 的独特玩法。自由搭配武器、机体、模组与宠物，打造天马行空的专属流派！简约线条，极致色彩！

games.name: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove!
games.short_description: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove! is a mash-up of the very best features of the classic console games with a ton of fresh improvements! Explore Earth as funky aliens from planet Funkotron trying to find your missing ship pieces to get back home in this casual co-op roguelike.

games.name: 传送地下城
games.short_description: 《传送地下城》是一款可供单人游玩，但同时也可以支持最多4人联机的国产Roguelite冒险闯关游戏。玩家作为一名冒险者，将和好友们在这地下城世界中，寻找最后的传送门，打败强大的敌人拯救世界。

games.name: Battle Bands: Rock & Roll Deckbuilder
games.short_description: Get the band together and take on the world in this battle of the bands, deckbuilding card game set in the fantasy land of Riff City. Play solo or with friends to conquer offbeat bosses in a coop campaign. Wits and a sick riff are key to becoming a rock legend.

games.name: Dream Quest
games.short_description: Play cards! Kill monsters! Level Up! Dream Quest is a roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the likes of Ascension, Magic: the Gathering, and Shandalar. Explore randomly generated levels as one of 13 classes in short, 30 minute, sessions.

games.name: A Legionary's Life
games.short_description: A Legionary's Life lets you play as a Roman soldier during the years of the Second Punic War and beyond. Rise up through the ranks and win prestigious awards or just focus on making it home in one piece; it's up to you.

games.name: QuiVr
games.short_description: QuiVr is the defining archery experience, made from the ground up for Virtual Reality. Grab your bow, arrows, and some friends to fight the enemy onslaught.

games.name: Phantomancer
games.short_description: Phantomancer is a deck-building roguelike where you summon phantoms to fight. Defeat the monsters threatening humanity and uncover the story of two sisters.

games.name: Repetendium
games.short_description: 与摧枯拉朽的元素生物大军在恐怖的矿洞中来一场酣畅淋漓的战斗！你还可以和全球玩家在排行榜上一决高下！看看谁才是《叽叽挖挖》的王者吧！

games.name: Deathless. The Hero Quest
games.short_description: 一款以古老斯拉夫传说为背景的Roguelike卡组构筑游戏，充满了史诗般的斯拉夫英雄与怪物。

games.name: Fabric Of Reality
games.short_description: In this game, you are the bullet hell. Face off against 100 waves of enemies and bosses by collecting a deck of attack cards that activate in real-time to unleash destruction upon everything in sight. There's an insane amount of customizability leading to an infinitely replayable experience.

games.name: 东方醉游稽传~Touhou Drunken Rebellion
games.short_description: 《东方醉游稽传 ~ Touhou Drunken Rebellion》是一款标准的俯视角弹幕射击式Roguelike游戏，游戏基于东方Project的世界观，玩家在游戏中将扮演各个生活在幻想乡中的小妖怪，向幻想乡的强权发起一场下克上的旅途

games.name: Knightica: Prologue
games.short_description: Recruit powerful units, place them strategically and find the best synergies in this Roguelike Autobattler! Discover optimal combinations, weave powerful enchants, face dangerous monsters and lead your army to victory!

games.name: Feed the Deep
games.short_description: 一款洛夫克拉夫特风格的roguelike游戏。潜入程序生成的海底洞穴。收集黄金，升级装备，尽在《喂养深渊》。

games.name: Steredenn: Binary Stars
games.short_description: Steredenn是一款激烈的、不规则的射击类游戏，嵌入大幅漂亮的像素，拥有疯狂的终极战斗。登上您的战舰并加入到永不停止对抗可怕的空间海盗的生存之战中。

games.name: 血海雷霆
games.short_description: 马修·金牛座，在一场可怕的事件中失去一切后，从受人尊敬的警察转变为复仇的亡命之徒。在这款疯狂的双摇杆射击类游戏中，准备好穿越危险的宇宙飞船，你必须找到你的敌人并摧毁他们。

games.name: Dandy Ace
games.short_description: 《卡牌艾斯》是一款夸大风格的动作游戏，跟随这位传说中的魔术师，力争将他的魔法卡组合运用，一路战斗和获得战利品，最终击败红眼魔术师，将自己从被诅咒魔镜中解放出来。

games.name: Tankenstein
games.short_description: Tankenstein is a 3rd person ARPG where the player controls a dishevelled tank in a post apocalyptic wasteland looking for new parts to survive and upgrade itself. All of the other tanks in the scrapyard have the same goal, which makes them hostile in this survival of the fittest arena.

games.name: Ufouria The Saga 2
games.short_description: 《Ufouria》是由SUNSOFT开发的横向卷轴游戏，游戏世界独特而又古怪，以探索为主要特色。每次游玩关卡时地形都会有所变化，因此玩家都能发现全新的秘密和挑战。这款《Ufouria》以迷人的手工毛毡风格重现了其奇异但可爱的世界。快来享受这个充满治愈和乐趣的全新体验吧！

games.name: 侍神大乱战
games.short_description: 《侍神大乱战Samurai Bringer》是随着每个阶段而产生变化的游戏。 对抗来自战国时代的众多武士和妖怪，提升战技，向讨伐八岐大蛇为目标进发的和风Roguelite动作游戏。

games.name: Inkshade
games.short_description: 《Inkshade》是一款极具特色的回合制策略游戏：千奇百怪的木质微模型，星罗棋布的上锁房间，更有一位超凡脱俗的游戏领主在幕后主使。胜利犹未可知，唯一不变的只有棋子体内流淌的残酷黑墨水。

games.name: Nightmare: The Lunatic
games.short_description: Nightmare: The Lunatic是一款关于逃离噩梦的格挡动作 Rogue-lite 平台游戏。不断切换3种武器，使用特殊攻击，躲避和格挡敌人的攻击。通过收集强大而独特的图腾来增强自己。

games.name: Cardinal Quest 2
games.short_description: Hack, slash and rush the forces of darkness. Assault castles and mountain lairs to liberate all in this super-sleek modernization of the classic roguelike formula! Will you play a crafting Alchemist, a sneaky backstabbing Thief... or something else?

games.name: Solace Inc.
games.short_description: A survivors-like about a time-travelling company where you recruit your employees against endless hordes of enemies.

games.name: Transliminal: Beyond The Backrooms
games.short_description: An unsettling rogue-lite survival horror adventure. Iconic levels reshape around you. Classic and original entities lurk as greater beings bid for your favor. Collect relics and strange items. Grow stronger. Survive, escape, or claim more uncertain fates. Fall in. Get lost. Go beyond The Backrooms.

games.name: Centipede Gun
games.short_description: Centipede Gun is a roguelite autobattler where you create bizzare creatures to face hordes of enemies! Combine different guns, modules and skills to make unique synergies and upgrade your cute little destruction machine!

games.name: 火焰审判 Trials of Fire
games.short_description: 《火焰审判》是一款策略与牌库构筑元素相结合的Roguelite游戏。 带领你的三位英雄，在大灾变后的不毛之地上展开冒险。 合理利用卡牌，移动英雄位置来与敌人战斗。 升级英雄，搜刮可改变牌库的装备，逐步武装自己的队伍，直至迎接最终挑战！

games.name: Aura of Worlds
games.short_description: 灵域是一款充满混乱与创意的策略Rogue-lite平台游戏。探索多个危险的世界，发挥你的想象力和环境优势。通过爆破、冲刺、抓取、战斗和魅惑等方式,穿越不断变化的死亡迷宫,智胜强大的守护者!

games.name: Peace Data
games.short_description: Peace Data — hard "Roguelike" game, in which you have to play for Bitard, saving Rusland from the tyranny of the authorities that destroyed the opposition and led the country to ruin, making slaves of citizens.

games.name: QUICKERFLAK 2
games.short_description: QUICKERFLAK 2 is a retro-hardcore room-beater time-attack super fast-paced minigame.

games.name: Crying Suns
games.short_description: 《哀恸之日》是一款类rogue-lite的战略游戏。你需要扮演太空舰队的指挥官，探索奇妙莫测的劫后帝国。游戏由故事情节驱动，剧情灵感源自经典科幻著作《沙丘》与《基地》。每当成功地完成目标之后，你都能知悉更多有关帝国……以及你自己的真相。

games.name: 露西的日记
games.short_description: Diary of Lucie is action-roguelite game made with RPG Maker. In addition to simply avoiding the enemy's barrage, strategically use the enemy's bullet to make the battle situation advantageous!

games.name: Over 9000 Zombies!
games.short_description: Over 9000 Zombies! is top-down arcade action blown out of all reasonable proportions. An endless horde of zombies is coming your way, how long can you survive?

games.name: 杀戮之源 / Rising Hell
games.short_description: 让你肾上腺素迸发的爽快动作和重金属音乐！《杀戮之源(Rising Hell)》是一个垂直地图的平台动作rogue-lite游戏，撕碎嗜血魔物，冲破变幻莫测的地狱！

games.name: 江湖幸存者
games.short_description: 有人存在的地方就是江湖，这是一款中国风风味的 Roguelite 轻度休闲游戏。浴血奋战杀出重重怪物的包围，可以孤军奋战，亦可叫上两三好友共同并肩作战。扮演不同角色，体会超多国风武侠招式，组建独特 Build 玩法，击败最终怪物，畅爽杀怪乐趣！

games.name: 868-HACK
games.short_description: You are a computer hacker. You steal precious data while the world sleeps.

games.name: World Seed Classic
games.short_description: A simple game with big ambitions. Fight creatures, explore the world and progress your character in this ever changing world.

games.name: 大千世界
games.short_description: 小明因黑人抬棺穿越到神秘新大陆开始了传（造）奇（孽）的一生。这是一款颠覆性的RPG扮演类游戏，是一个完全的开放性世界，你不再被主线剧情所拘束可以自由的在这个世界的各个角落探索，寻找宝物，或是完成一件件难忘的冒险。在游戏中做一个坏人亦或者是一个好人都由你自己决定，你还可以加入各种门派，学习绝学，制作装备炼制法宝等等，直到你从一个屌丝成长为一个大屌丝！

games.name: 肉鸽弹弹奇兵
games.short_description: 规划、瞄准、发射！《肉鸽弹弹奇兵》既有桌面弹球的爽快手感，又有回合制类Rogue游戏的策略深度。快来打出异想天开的各种连招，解锁角色、物品和技能，征服这座海岛吧！

games.name: Breach Wanderers
games.short_description: 全新演绎肉鸽（Roguelike）卡牌构筑游戏，每回合都可对卡组进行优化，调整策略从而取得胜利。超千张卡牌可供选择，还有十名技能独特的英雄，及数十种物品和任务助你优化战术。

games.name: THE SPIRIT LIFT
games.short_description: A retro horror deckbuilder roguelike set in a haunted hotel in the 1990s. Choose your teens, explore and fight! If you die rewind the night!

games.name: Arcane Raiders
games.short_description: Team up with your wizard friends to pillage the magic tower! Create elemental synergies, defeat powerful bosses and claim the tower's treasure in this rogue-like dungeon-raider.

games.name: GunSuit Guardians
games.short_description: Gear up your GunSuit and defend Earth from an alien siege! Equip and upgrade unique arsenals of overpowered weapons to survive overwhelming numbers in this action-roguelite twin-stick horde survival.

games.name: X Invader: Prologue
games.short_description: 动作日志灯光游戏X Invader的免费版本。 成为黑客大师“X”，入侵数字世界。 使用各种武器和黑客插件创建自己的战斗版本，消灭干扰的敌人。

games.name: Maze Mice
games.short_description: 迷宫鼠《Maze Mice》是一款只有玩家移动时，时间才会流逝的Roguelite弹幕游戏。收集积分点，升级，选择强化，并避开猫咪。一切选择，由你自己掌控。

games.name: TOP DOG
games.short_description: Dogfight your way through short, intense and randomized runs. Hard but easy to pickup, with daily leaderboards and minimum hardware requirements

games.name: 👑 选王之剑 👑
games.short_description: Rogue爬塔+放置养成+创意工坊+像素即时群战+无氪抽卡+砍杀大世界！实验性功能人工智能NPC， 组成队伍在随机关卡或大世界之中冒险挑战，攻略城池，养成发展。 （可肝可摸鱼，泳装/福瑞DLC，支持创意工坊，欢迎进群交流、吹水、分享，以及定期打折！）

games.name: Concrete Jungle
games.short_description: A city planning deck-building game. Place buildings using cards in your deck and earn new ones as you progress! A genre-blending game packed with cool ideas that swaps micro-management for a more puzzle-like approach to city planning.

games.name: Rogue Star Rescue
games.short_description: 子弹地狱狂热+塔防策略。 《流氓星救援》是一款不同寻常的新型rogue-like射击游戏。在援救队友并为您的防御策略收集陷阱的同时，一路狂轰滥炸闯荡众多星球。无论你是选择单枪匹马作孤胆英雄，还是在线组队携手攻克难关，一定要在流氓星毁灭一切之前阻止它！

games.name: Monster Bullets
games.short_description: Monster Bullets is a first-person roguelite where each monster has a specific weakness. Quickly load the correct bullet for each monster and fire them off! Experiment with upgrades on each procedurally generated attempt and try to slay the goblin king!

games.name: 变量 Variables
games.short_description: 我们将塔防游戏与Roguelike游戏相结合，制作出了这款单机游戏。 快来搭建你的迷宫，修造你的防御塔，击败那些入侵的怪物，拯救这个世界吧！

games.name: Relic Dudes
games.short_description: 独自或与最多4位朋友一起击败成群的敌人！在这款多人在线生存风格的Roguelike游戏中，你可以选择合作或互相捣乱，打造独特的构建，改变团队的命运。

games.name: Straimium Immortaly
games.short_description: Straimium Immortaly is a shmup roguelike dungeoncrawler. Explore the butts-hard procedurally generated Cubicus battling beasties, looting endless item and weapon upgrades and defeating huge boss meanies in your vengeful quest to eradicate the Queeni Emperess.

games.name: Wayward
games.short_description: You awake to discover yourself no longer in the company of good men or a fine seafaring vessel. Treasure... you remember something about treasure. Wayward is a challenging turn-based, top-down, wilderness survival roguelike. Explore, build, and most importantly survive in these unforgiving lands.

games.name: Mobmania
games.short_description: Mobmania is a four (4) player co-op real-time bullet-hell action rogue-like where you kill enemies, buy items after leveling up, and survive long enough against thousands of monsters and bosses until the final fight against the Witch.

games.name: 天外武林 (Traveler of Wuxia)
games.short_description: 《天外武林》是一款以卡牌构筑为基础的Rogue-lite武侠游戏，融合精彩的武侠剧情与丰富的卡牌组合。由玩家扮演的少年英雄，穿越到一个未知的武林世界，通过卡牌的连携套路来施展绝技，与同伴协力，共同应对江湖中的挑战。
dev: 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司
pub: 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司

games.name: Nevergrind Online
games.short_description: Nevergrind Online 是一款终极多人地下城探索角色扮演游戏，专注于寻宝和杀死怪物，无需烦人的微交易！ 创建你自己的英雄并开始攀登阶梯！ 硬核模式专为寻求终极挑战的玩家而设！

games.name: 第九圣诗
games.short_description: 组合宝石，打出连击！ 《第九圣诗》是一款肉鸽宝石策略游戏。玩家可以在游戏中体验到酣畅淋漓的连击战斗！ 你将化身秘密组织“第九圣诗”的特工，迎战强敌！ 巧妙利用策略，构建宝石出击顺序，实现大量连击吧！

games.name: Lhama Clicker Prologue
games.short_description: Lhama Clicker is a clicker game about reproduce an infinitly amount of lhamas, to increase your production to ridiculous numbers

games.name: My life as an archeologist
games.short_description: Click your way through 100 levels of archeological treasure hunting, loot and improve your equipment, uncover build-defining artefacts on every boss, choose between three different classes and find the one that best fits your playstyle! Research monsters cards and improve every run!

games.name: Catacomb Kids
games.short_description: Catacomb Kids is a brutal platformer roguelike that pits you against the deadly Catacombs aided only by magic, steel, and your quick reflexes. Traverse procedurally generated dungeons and hack, slash, burn, and blast your way through hordes of things that want to kill you.

games.name: Debugging Hero
games.short_description: 作为被传说之剑选中的调试英雄，你获得了操控角色变量的能力！ 利用这股强大的力量，突破挡在你面前的地下城，打倒魔王吧！

games.name: 水星潮
games.short_description: 《水星潮》是一款由卡牌驱动的Roguelike角色扮演游戏。你将扮演一名迷失于失落森林中的旅人。招募队友，收集资源，合成物品，探索世界，击败敌人，找到自己的归途，或揭开这个世界的秘密。

games.name: Spartan Survivors
games.short_description: Fight hordes of Covenant & Flood in this new game mixing Roguelite & Bullet Heaven for hours of mindless fun!

games.name: Cosmochoria
games.short_description: A tiny, naked cosmonaut with a jetpack & laser blaster must revive a dying galaxy by planting one seed at a time. An innovative and addictive arcade adventure experience with mystery and intrigue in all the right places.

games.name: Antivirus PROTOCOL
games.short_description: Antivirus PROTOCOL 是一款关于消灭病毒的增量游戏。学习并适应，收集数据，升级自己，消灭已经占领世界的病毒。

games.name: Bling Bling Bankruptcy
games.short_description: Gamble, survive, and outplay your debt! In Bling Bling Bankruptcy, you’re deep in the red, and the only way out is through high-stakes gambling. Play Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Plinko, and more, buy items for bonuses, and survive as many days as possible!

games.name: 时行者：黑暗世界
games.short_description: 《时行者黑暗世界》是一款肉鸽自走棋游戏。玩家将在一波又一波的战斗中拾取80+种技能。 随意搭配技能组合与时行者职业，优化队伍配置和战斗站位， 还可以通过战斗累积解锁新职业的时行者和天赋！ 请完成黑暗世界更深处的探索吧...

games.name: FrankenStorm TD: Prologue
games.short_description: Roguelite TD: all towers & enemies start the same, but you have 1 choice per wave affecting BOTH and stacking up for dramatic variance. Gradually salvage and make some choices permanent to build deeper strategies. Also a unique mazing challenge where wires and towers must be linked to a power source

games.name: Hyperspace Dogfights
games.short_description: Hyperspace Dogfights is a juicy jet-combat roguelite in which you blast, dodge and slice your way through masses of technologically inferior baddies. Your jet evolves differently on each run and becomes stronger and weirder by gathering some of the 300+ available items.

games.name: Slay or Fall
games.short_description: 作为地下城的领主，在英雄们袭击你之前保护自己免受他们的攻击！管理自己的下属，策划阴谋，解决燃眉之急！

games.name: 荣耀死斗2 - Mortal Glory 2
games.short_description: 在这款回合制奇幻Roguelike游戏中管理一支流浪的角斗士小队。找到最优秀的新人、探索强大的物品组合、并在战场上发掘出机智的战术。竞技场等待着那些渴望着荣耀死斗的人们！

games.name: In Celebration of Violence
games.short_description: A fantasy action roguelike of exploration and murder. Live, kill, die, improve, live again.

games.name: Samurai Shampoo Classic
games.short_description: Melee-based roguelike dungeon crawler where a fallen samurai must retrieve his stolen Shampoo. Make your run unique by selecting unique perks, picking a weapon when you start a run, picking up items and weapons from chests, and buying them from shops.

games.name: None Shall Intrude: Descent
games.short_description: 进入None Shall Intrude，这是一款基于地块战斗的rougelike卡牌游戏，你可以在游戏中化身强大的突袭Boss。史诗般的战斗、错综复杂的策略，以及来自想要摧毁你统治的英雄无时无刻的威胁。你会征服一切还是败给英勇的英雄？

games.name: Poker Quest: Swords and Spades
games.short_description: Poker Quest is a fantasy roguelike where players use a standard 52-card deck to take on fierce enemies in epic battles. Featuring over 20 unique heroes, thousands of items, and deep gameplay that will test even the most experienced players.

games.name: Dark Lord
games.short_description: 尽情施展力量，称霸《Dark Lord》！这款肉鸽角色扮演游戏融合了策略、冒险以及玩世不恭的幽默。对不断壮大的王国进行铁腕统治，加固要塞，同时提防不要被顾问背后捅刀子！

games.name: Dungeon CEO Demo
games.short_description: 扮演维多利亚时代的地下城首席执行官。管理资源、招募怪物、定制卡组，在回合制战斗中占据优势。在这个充满冒险和神灵的世界里，智取对手，获取金币，带领地下城公司取得胜利。

games.name: 锄禾日当午
games.short_description: 来自一名热爱大自然的丹麦老哥的自走棋游戏，让你的水果和蔬菜变得栩栩如生！ 按照特定的模式种植农作物，并有策略地放置它们，以抵御老鼠、狗头人甚至龙。

games.name: 荣耀死斗 Mortal Glory
games.short_description: Mortal Glory（荣耀死斗）是一款幻想主题的战术类Roguelike游戏，招募和训练角斗士，让他们相互厮杀 – 竭尽全力赢得荣耀！

games.name: Slimekeep
games.short_description: Slimekeep 是一款节奏快速的类 Rogue 游戏，拥有独特的决策和引人入胜的玩家自由度。你需要杀死并捕捉各种史莱姆，以阻止他们占领这片土地。探索自动生成的关卡，并在阻止史莱姆王，以免为时已晚。

games.name: DECIDIT
games.short_description: Decidit is a fast FPS roguelike in which you must use all the arsenal and movement abilities at your disposal in order to progress in an unstable demonic maze. Be fast, precise but also strategic using all the demonic weapons and abilities collected on the way to create powerful synergies.

games.name: Calculate It
games.short_description: We've made a calculator roguelike! Yes, it's not a joke. A boring device has turned into an interesting strategy, where each calculator you collect sets its own style of play. Can you count all the numbers and prove who's the king of calculations here?

games.name: Blast-off
games.short_description: Blast-off is a hardcore jumper/runner/shmup, where your alter ego will be a ball of anti-matter seeking to leave our Universe. Anti-matter is extremely difficult to exist in our universe, because when it contact with matter it annihilates.

games.name: 萝莉的远征
games.short_description: 游戏讲述在元宇宙盛行的时代，人们只要通过专用设备进入梦境，就能和全世界的人一起游玩。但梦境似乎正在入侵着真实的世界，为了揭开事件的真相，大家竭尽所能展开了调查……

games.name: Seek Girl:Fog Ⅰ
games.short_description: 《Seek Girl: Fog I》是一款策略冒險類游戲,你將在神秘迷霧中解救被困女孩。 王國森林突然出現的迷霧將女孩們困在其中，神秘的力量不斷侵蝕著王國。 你是一位勇士被國王招募去解救迷失的女孩，隨著在迷霧中的探險會慢慢解開迷霧秘密和隱藏在背後巨大的陰謀。

games.name: Sublevel Zero Redux
games.short_description: Sublevel Zero Redux is a roguelite six-degree-of-freedom shooter in a universe where reality is falling apart. Use your zero-g gunship to fight through a vast underground facility, looting advanced weapons to destroy hordes of deadly enemies.

games.name: 零异机动队
games.short_description: 这是一款黑暗赛博朋克世界观卡牌构筑游戏，你将带领反抗军三人小队对抗引发世界大战的多方势力。为每位队员搭配独立套牌，装换各式植入体，不断构筑牌组以击败各地区的首领。最终揭开余烬之城的秘密。

games.name: Spooky Station
games.short_description: Welcome to Spooky Station! Prepare to be amazed and bewildered by our enigmas and puzzles, afraid of our deadly enemies and extremely challenging bosses. Tons of exciting stories and distinct fictional worlds await for you in this mysterious pack!

games.name: Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者
games.short_description: 《伊泰恩：魔法幸存者》是一款俯视角的竞技场射击生存类roguelite游戏。你可以通过魔法，神器，天赋，塔罗牌构筑你的技能组合。是成为刀枪不入的铁壁法师，还是成为屠杀敌人的毁灭法师，全看你的选择！当你面对成千上万的怪物时，你能活下来吗? 活下来能解锁RSQ的CG哦，可以看到美少女娇羞的，涩涩的样子^_^

games.name: 弹反者
games.short_description: 《弹反者Deflector》是一款俯视视角的roguelite游戏，背景设定在致命的微观世界。深入充满病毒的敌对世界。用你的武器并偏转敌人的投射物来击倒越来越具有挑战性的敌人。生存、死亡、变强，直到拥有足够的实力直面万物之源！

games.name: Space Scavenger
games.short_description: 在清理飞船零件的时候，设计、建造和指挥独特的宇宙飞船来穿越神秘外星人出没的星系，努力寻找曾经称之为家的地方。

games.name: RollScape
games.short_description: 在这款简单快捷、爽感爆棚但又引人入胜的肉鸽游戏中，掷骰子、制定策略并升级你的胜利之路。 你能在投掷机会用完之前走到尽头吗？ 不断倍乘！！

games.name: 迷失幻途
games.short_description: 《迷失幻途》是一款以卡牌构筑为核心，并深度融合了棋盘策略玩法的Roguelite 游戏。你将从6名独特角色中选择其一，踏上随机生成的冒险之路用奇思妙想构筑自己的牌库，收集数量丰富的道具与秘宝，击败敌人们并探寻这个世界的秘密!

games.name: Increlution
games.short_description: Survive the ever increasing pressure of time for as long as you can! A minimalistic incremental game about time management that takes inspiration from roguelite games, with a focus on meta-progression. Every generation has a better chance at survival, because previous lives influence its instincts

games.name: FLERP
games.short_description: Fend off hordes of enemies in this arcade tower defense roguelite with autobattler elements. Build up a team of powerful synergies and become unstoppable.

games.name: 环形子弹
games.short_description: 《环形子弹（Orbital Bullet）》是一款rogue-lite快节奏360°平台动作游戏，所有的战斗都在循环场景中展开。强化并改造武器和躯体，在程序生成的世界中杀出一条血路！

games.name: Runestone Keeper
games.short_description: 符石守护者是一款基于方格探索和战斗的回合制地牢爬行类游戏。混合了RPG和卡片的核心要素，选择英雄探索危险的地牢，灵活的运用道具与技能对抗强力的怪物，致命的陷阱以及各类突发事件。

games.name: 异界失控
games.short_description: 《异界失控》是一款可以走位的Roguelite战术回合制游戏。你将率领一支毛茸茸的作战小队，在横版一维战场上闪转腾挪，与神秘的异变怪物展开殊死搏斗，一步步探索超自然灾害背后的真相……

games.name: 形骸骑士
games.short_description: 神秘的瘟疫，突然降临在古老的塞勒菲斯，当白虎双子深陷其中，他们将如何选择？平台动作Roguelite游戏《Kelipot》到来！丰富的剧情、逐帧绘制的动画以及手绘2D风格的场景，探寻其中并找到疯狂世界之下的真相吧！

games.name: METALLIC CHILD
games.short_description: 『抓取、投掷、破坏』rogue-lite・动作核心游戏!! 宇宙船生命之流号上发生了大规模的叛乱事件。为了阻止这场叛乱的元凶，同时也是创造出机械少女――《METALLIC CHILD》洛娜的艾琳博士，洛娜在身为玩家的你的操作下，展开了与巨大机器人的战斗。

games.name: bit Dungeon
games.short_description: bitDungeon combines randomized loot and fast action combat, explore randomized dungeons and hack and slash your way through dangerous bosses. The difficultly increases as you become stronger and stronger. Build your character how you want with deadly passive abilities.

games.name: FORWARD: Escape the Fold - Ultimate Edition
games.short_description: 《FORWARD: Escape the Fold - 终极版》旨在打造完美的迷你型地牢探险卡牌游戏。选择你的冠军，面对对你无情的地下城探险，收集物品增强你的能力，击败面前可怕的怪物。但要不断向前前进！

games.name: Fantasy Survivors
games.short_description: A rogue-lite where you fight thousands of creatures, unlocking characters and equipment, to challenge deeper levels. Team up with friends or go solo; all drops are instanced so you don't have to share. Satisfying gameplay combined with smart choices make one-more-run a no-brainer.

games.name: Minesweeper: Collector
games.short_description: Tired of boring common square levels? Finally there is a brand new minesweeper with different game modes! Each level is a part of collection. Complete collections to obtain keys and gain access for more episodes. Achieve higher levels to unlock new items, chests, pets and much more!

games.name: Wacky West
games.short_description: Wacky West 带来你从那些假冒跑酷手机广告中期待的动作，但这次是真正的游戏！沉浸在快节奏的末日世界中，对抗变异怪物，创造酷炫的连击组合，打造武器，并在荒地中生存下去。

games.name: 魔塔少女
games.short_description: 《魔塔少女》是一款融合了爬塔和Roguelike的美少女自走棋游戏。玩家将招募各式各样的随从，搭配不同的流派和阵容，去往数个未知的关卡，和实力强劲的敌人战斗，养成自己的冒险团阵容。和美少女同伴一起，踏上前往黑神塔的危险旅途。

games.name: Destropolis
games.short_description: 毁灭之城》是一款自上而下的射击游戏，游戏中拥有一个完全可破坏的环境，数百个敌人和核爆炸。与无数的敌人群殴。用子弹、激光和爆炸将他们撕成碎片。在他们压倒你之前尽可能多地摧毁他们...

games.name: Son of a Witch
games.short_description: 至多四人的线上合作，还有萌萌哒画风，不同职业道具武器药剂卷轴各种要素roguelike游戏在这里！你能否找到遗失的地精神器呢？与小伙伴们一同出发吧！Q群：247727900

games.name: 太古之火
games.short_description: 这是一款Roguelike与战棋融合的单机策略游戏。作为曾经先民的指引者，你降临并苏醒，以星使之名，前往人族营地，带领天赋和能力迥异的不同氏族勇士，前往危机四伏的大荒冒险，寻找遗落的先民历史和灾厄来源的真相……

games.name: Asura: Vengeance Edition
games.short_description: 《战神阿修罗》是一款以印度神话为题材的暗黑风格Rogue-like游戏，有着富有趣味的技能系统。在游戏中玩家将化身为复仇的阿修罗，一路攻破帝国的要塞。你需要通过多种武器与人物职业配合，辅以不同的技能进行组合来让自己变得更加强大。这款游戏也许有些野蛮，但十分公平。

games.name: Rogue Empire: Dungeon Crawler RPG
games.short_description: 打造独特的职业与种族组合，塑造你的天赋路线，并在这款战术 Roguelike 地牢探索游戏中考验你的策略。游戏包含战役、挑战模式、战利品、Boss 战，以及经得起反复游玩的深度内容。

games.name: 大魔法师立花
games.short_description: ★★「大魔法师立花」集合系列两部作品，2合1剧情，一份的价格双倍的快乐！★★为了追回领主贪污的非法财产，立花前去执行任务。 却落入领主提前布置的陷阱——一座地下迷宫。 虽说其中的魔物都是杂鱼般的存在， 但同时存在的各种陷阱却让逃离充满了变数！

games.name: DROP - System Breach
games.short_description: Welcome to DROP, a fast-paced action-strategy hacking simulator. Ready to hack your way to fame and fortune while avoiding getting caught? Use stealth and cunning to maneuver between the ongoing power struggle of corporations and factions to control the fragmented networks in the city.

games.name: 超增税都市
games.short_description: 轻松愉快的全新体验，也可挑战你的策略极限，《超增税都市》——化身税收狂魔吧！ 融合城市建设与 Roguelite，你需要从随机设施中精妙组合、动态布局，打造赚钱机器；烧脑决策、硬核挑战，快来开启城建幻想，征服环环相扣的盈利迷宫！

games.name: GemCrusty
games.short_description: Dig, Discover, Date! Gemcrusty is a casual mining game, where precious gemstones are actually gems in human form.

games.name: 血牌2:浓雾
games.short_description: 《浓雾》是一款结合了Roguelike元素的卡牌游戏。浓雾具有特殊的游戏机制，你需要组建套牌来消灭怪物，探索雾中的秘密。

games.name: Desktop Dungeons
games.short_description: 《桌面地下城》是一款由QCF Design制作发行奇幻背景的快节奏roguelike解密游戏。 游戏中，你将扮演一位王国的管理者，派遣不同种族、职业的英雄前往各种各样的地下城冒险，挑战种类繁多，特性不一的敌人，同时利用所获取的资源逐步将王国发展壮大。

games.name: VAR: Exterminate
games.short_description: 『 VAR: Exterminate 』是首款VR Rogue Like 僵尸射击游戏。努力生存下去吧！透过不断选取各种特色的能力卡、收集资源升级强力装备，歼灭一波接一波的僵尸浪潮。准备好迎接这款拥有无限可能与超强力爽快的僵尸射击游戏！

games.name: Cryptical Path
games.short_description: 《水晶之路》(Cryptical Path) 是一款惊悚刺激、不拘一格的浪客式地牢爬行游戏。扮演建筑师角色，打造你自己的路径，并征服一个你身陷其中且不断变化着的迷宫。

games.name: Roots of Yggdrasil
games.short_description: 在这个《诸神黄昏》后的 Roguelike 城市建造游戏中，建造定居点，探索九个境界，收集神器并升级你的卡组，以达到 Yggdrasil 的顶端！你能否在世界末日中生存下来？

games.name: Everlasting Flowers - Where there is a will, there is a way
games.short_description: 来自sprite（《恋爱与选举与巧克力》《苍之彼方的四重奏》）的最新献礼，为大家呈现一段催人泪下的动人故事

games.name: 将熄之焰：序章
games.short_description: 天下英雄尽入彀中！《将熄之焰：序章》是正式版发售前推出的免费独立序章版本，讲述了正传剧情之前的故事。本作是一款非传统，无羁绊的自走棋游戏

games.name: Deathstate: Abyssal Edition
games.short_description: Deathstate is a roguelike bullet hell adventure set in a bizarre world of dimensional exploration. Play as a number of unique characters trying to discover the fate of Professor Elinberg who opened a portal to the void. Are you ready to venture deep into the abyss?

games.name: Zombie Party
games.short_description: Zombie Party is a retro rampage of fun and over-the-top action, while still giving the players a deep and engaging Action-RPG Rogue-like experience! Go on a time traveling adventure, or delve deep into procedural dungeons full of gold, loot, and secrets!

games.name: Galactic Mining Corp
games.short_description: Galactic Mining Corp is a unique rogue-lite, action game with crafting and base building mechanics. Head into uncharted space and discover a universe of locations to exploit for riches! Use your profits to expand your HQ, hire a crazy work force, obtain new drill components and upgrade everything.

games.name: Superbugs: Awaken
games.short_description: A Communication-Based, Co-Op game for 2P. Play either as the Scientist or the Hunter with communication as your only weapon to save your precious cat, Mimi, from deadly Superbugs!

games.name: Choo Choo Survivor
games.short_description: 到安全地带去。在击退越来越多的僵尸的同时移动你的列车。升级你的武器和能力，变得更加强大！

games.name: Gloomgrave
games.short_description: Gloomgrave is a roguelike turn-based dungeon crawler where you will explore, loot, and fight your way through the ever-shifting dungeon to defeat the evil that lies below.

games.name: Ambition: A Minuet in Power
games.short_description: 18th century Paris - a city of love, lies and revolution. You are a woman of fashion trying to survive the political turmoil. Date a cast of unforgettable characters. Amass the wealth and respect you deserve. Engage in gossip that can alter the course of history, or lead you to the guillotine.

games.name: 元气小剧场
games.short_description: 作为《通神榜》的开发团队，元气弹工作室带来了他们的新作《元气小剧场》。这是一款集自动战斗和牌组构建于一体的轻度策略肉鸽游戏。玩家将扮演一位主演，招募组建自己的剧组，在舞台上演绎精彩战斗，赢得台下粉丝的喝彩与打赏，直至谢幕。

games.name: ROSE
games.short_description: ROSE is a violent rogue-lite arena shooter where you sacrifice your body parts to progress and gain new weapons and abilities. Slaughter waves of monstrous enemies and defeat titanic bosses in randomized arenas or die trying!

games.name: Fallback
games.short_description: Lead the rebellion in an epic rogue-like adventure. Guide your jet-pack equipped post-apocalyptic volunteers through a labyrinthine underground complex by jumping, dodging, and battling against robot minions (and masters) to get to the surface — and bring life back to the scorched Earth.

games.name: In Woods
games.short_description: In Woods是一款以森林为背景的肉鸽生存游戏。在充满挑战的森林中，你需要与各种怪物激烈战斗，不断提升等级，收集木材来制作物品，强化能力，以应对更强大的敌人。随着时间推移，挑战将越来越艰难，最终目标是生存下去并击败终极Boss，取得最终胜利！

games.name: Nebula
games.short_description: Survive in the deep void of the galaxy against thousands of invaders! Nebula is a challenging bullet hell, twin stick shooter where you have to face endless waves of space enemies. Additional map resources and space drones can provide you a support but be wary, they can as well become a deadly trap.

games.name: 红石遗迹 - Red Obsidian Remnant
games.short_description: 这是一款Roguelike玩法和动作系统相结合的地牢游戏
pub: Beijing New Era Network Technology Co., Ltd.

games.name: 沦陷
games.short_description: 这是一款带有战略性的俯视角单人rogue-lite动作冒险游戏，昔日世界几乎被丧尸侵占，你将扮演仅存的幸存者营地指挥官，为最后的幸存者同伴们寻找希望，组建并指派你的特警小队，去探索这遍地是丧尸的末日世界吧！

games.name: MidBoss
games.short_description: Kill your enemies, possess their bodies, and take their abilities as your own in this turn-based procedurally generated death labyrinth.

games.name: I Am Overburdened
games.short_description: I Am Overburdened is a silly turn-based roguelike full of crazy artifacts and a "hero" who has 20 inventory slots.

games.name: MYRIAD DEATH
games.short_description: 这是一款能灵活运用不同性能武器进行战斗的爽快动作射击游戏。

games.name: 异世界创造者
games.short_description: 自由度相当高的Roguelike RPG（类迷宫探索型角色扮演游戏）。可以冒险、交流、结婚、偷窃、农业、钓鱼、锻造、冶炼、调配、建设城镇等等，能不受目的限制，自由地游玩！

games.name: 美好家园与地下城
games.short_description: 在幻想的世界里冒险・采集・建造城镇・过上梦想中的慢生活，是这款RPG游戏的主打特色！在体验RPG内容的同时，还可以享受到其他丰富多彩的要素！些许的好奇心便能带你领略这款独一无二的日式RPG游戏。一起来探索吧！！！

games.name: Mistress of Maids: First Castle
games.short_description: You wanted to congratulate the king on his birthday and presented him a fabulous pudding. You have never seen such a happy king, his happiness knew no bounds. Everyone had fun! But at the most solemn moment, the pudding gave an angry cry: "AAAAA".

games.name: Keep Keepers
games.short_description: Tower Defense meets Base Management. Strategically place your defenses. Craft wacky ammunition like fiery peppers and boomerang bananas. Discover amazing weapons and automate your economy while defending against waves of enemies. Can you handle the chaos?

games.name: State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem
games.short_description: 准备开始弹幕游戏，疯狂操纵吧！你的小镇着火了，无政府主义在街道横行，外星人在空中肆虐！拿起你的枪参加战斗！

games.name: 炮舰外交：预备装弹
games.short_description: 在末日废土中化身一台毁灭机甲，准备体验一场刺激的歼灭战吧！面对海啸般的外星异形，你需要通过战斗回收武器模组并制作出最强大的武器！在敌人的重重围剿下杀出一条求生之路，最终进化成一台移动的死亡泰坦，成为战场上的传奇！

games.name: The Fall of the Dungeon Guardians - Enhanced Edition
games.short_description: In this tactical combat & dungeon crawler mash-up, explore a massive dungeon, full of danger, mystery and secrets. Fight your way through hordes of enemies and powerful creatures, with your tank, healer & damage dealers party.

games.name: Neon Village
games.short_description: 这款游戏是“策略模拟类roguelike游戏”与“三消益智”结合的游戏。收集个性丰富的居民，产生爆炸性的协同效应，发展闪烁着霓虹的村庄！

games.name: 魔书射爆
games.short_description: 魔书射爆是一款以一本书为主角的塔防肉鸽游戏，你魂穿异世界附身于魔书，《母猪的产后护理》《阴阳学》《五年高考，三年模拟》曾经你耳熟能详的书籍带给你与众不同的魔法，搭配不同的学院，学习九大天启魔法，来一场酣畅淋漓的魔法对轰！

games.name: 旅者 Travelers
games.short_description: 一款轻量级的策略旅行模拟。你将扮演一位古代旅者，饱览各地风景，撰写自己的游记，留名青史。

games.name: Alquiem
games.short_description: Alquiem is a new Medieval RPG made by a solo-dev in which you will be able to gain strength through numerous classes and talent trees, professions and equipment to face the creatures that inhabit the lands of Odenzur.

games.name: 纸境英雄 Papercraft
games.short_description: 《纸境英雄》是一款融合了Roguelike+战棋+DBG元素的独立游戏。传说中的不同英雄将携带不同的卡牌，结合战棋的战斗形式，如何游戏完全由玩家自己做主。
pub: Shenzhen Tanyu Interactive Entertainment Co., Ltd.

games.name: Spell Defender
games.short_description: Spell Defender is a 3D, Third-Person, wave defence, survival Roguelite. Use magical powers to defeat waves of enemies. Each wave rewards you with a choice of a new power. Find synergies and combine these powers to create the ultimate defender.

games.name: Below the Stone
games.short_description: Below the Stone is an extraction roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

games.name: Paper Planet
games.short_description: 《纸弹星球》是一款街机式类Rogue游戏，其主题为保卫星球，艺术风格灵感来源于涂鸦和Flash动画。在游戏中，你将迎战一波又一波独具特色的敌兵与首领，通过组合具有奇特古怪效果的道具，用毁天灭地的力量通关。游戏支持1～4名玩家本地联机，在混乱的合作中寻找乐趣吧！

games.name: Space Tyrant
games.short_description: Terrorize the galaxy for fun and profit! Space Tyrant is a surprisingly deep beer & pretzels strategy game set in a darkly humorous future. Build a mighty space force, disintegrate peaceful aliens, and rule irresponsibly on your relentless march to total domination.

games.name: Crystal Guardians TD
games.short_description: Crystal Guardians is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Fight of waves and defend the world crystal. Gear up your towers with a powerful combination of items for your strategy. In an ever expanding map, find hidden powers and conquer the enemies.

games.name: 3 Days War
games.short_description: 《三日战争》是一款独特的多人对战策略战争游戏。融合了RTS+4X的机制规则，让数十玩家在同一战场中，合作、对抗、背叛、联合，进行一场持续三天的即时大战略竞技。指挥官们，用你们的技巧、策略、博弈甚至欺骗，成为最终的胜利者吧！

games.name: Nakuma
games.short_description: Nakuma is a singleplayer RPG with focus on grinding for gear and experience points. Obtain a variety of magical spells, upgrade your gear and invest stat-points as you progress!

games.name: Facehand
games.short_description: Facehand 是一款采用自动战斗机制的协同作用驱动型 roguelike 卡组构建游戏。打造完美的卡组，并将卡牌能力连锁，创造出狂野的组合！

games.name: Slash or Die
games.short_description: In this game you will face violence and extraordinary complexity. You will have to become one of three heroes to slash enemies or to die from their hands. What will your hero do? It depends only on your skills…

games.name: Sweet Surrender VR
games.short_description: Sweet Surrender is a fast-paced roguelike VR shooter. Fight your way up a dystopian megatower, filled to the brim with tyrant machines hell-bent on destroying the last of humanity. Build your arsenal of weapons, upgrades, and explosives to take down the machine overlords.

games.name: 邪恶巢穴设计师 Chambers of Devious Design
games.short_description: 《邪恶巢穴设计师》是一款充满战术性的基地建设类游戏，你被指派为一位邪恶首脑建造一座邪恶巢穴，但是要小心！并不是只有你一个人在试图夺得老大的青睐，想出充满创意的设计、给你的竞争者们下套吧！

games.name: Sword of the Necromancer - Prologue
games.short_description: 使用死灵法师之剑的禁忌力量化敌为友，并帮助Tama到达地牢深处，获得足够的力量将Koko从死地带出。

games.name: Frost
games.short_description: Frost is a Survival solo Card game. Inspired by deck-building board games like Dominion, Ascension and the like, it's an unique take on the genre as it puts you in charge of a group of people struggling against a restless, lethal storm.

games.name: 黄金与坟墓
games.short_description: 《Gold and Graves》是一款类Roguelike提取玩法游戏，玩家可以贿赂敌人，将其招募为盟友，逃离地下城，并将卡牌、遗物和雇佣兵带回村庄，积累资源。利用积累的资源强化卡组和战斗力，挑战更深层的地下城吧。

games.name: Crafty Survivors
games.short_description: 英雄们都被腐化了！解锁各怀绝艺的角色，利用他们的独特技能，打造独属于你自己的角色构筑，保护家园、征讨来敌。积聚资源、重建村庄，打造属于自己的道路，剑指邪恶诅咒之源头！

games.name: 未元物质 Primateria
games.short_description: 在《未元物质》中踏上一段史诗般的旅程，这是一款重新定义了肉鸽卡牌游戏的游戏，并向经典的《游戏王》体验致敬。融合卡牌，与神灵战斗，在充满挑战和惊喜的宇宙中航行。体验无穷无尽的组合和战术深度带来的快感。

games.name: 魔物娘与不可思议的冒险～力量宝珠与回归之塔～
games.short_description: 让魔物娘们成为「仲魔」然后一起去冒险吧！ 这是每次进入地形都会改变的「不可思议的迷宫」风格的Roguelike游戏。

games.name: bit Dungeon II
games.short_description: bitDungeon II is fast action-adventure game with a giant overworld to explore. You are a spirit in an undead world of demons. Your "loved one's " grave has been desecrated. Fight through these corrupted lands, and bring peace to her soul.

games.name: Psycho Starship Rampage
games.short_description: You play the psychotic A.I. of a warship lost in space which tries to come back to Earth. Build your spaceship from scratch. Load it with weapons. And use your creation to destroy waves of innocent aliens throughout numerous levels. Loot their carcasses, extend your ship and jump to the next sector for more action!

games.name: Slyders
games.short_description: Slyders 是一款结合了快节奏射击动作和极致升级系统的 FPS 生存类肉鸽弹幕游戏。你将扮演艾瑞克斯，一位无畏的狐狸自由战士，他骑着超音速战斗乌龟，目标是解放被邪恶统治的天空世界。

games.name: Xeno Crisis
games.short_description: Xeno Crisis is an arena shooter in which up to two players take control of battle-hardened marines embarking on a deadly mission to confront an alien menace! Run and gun your way through thousands of adversaries, searching for survivors, and ultimately facing the origin of the outpost's demise.

games.name: In Death
games.short_description: Created exclusively for VR, In Death is a Roguelite Shooter set in the godless afterlife. Battle through procedurally generated levels and dungeons in intense ranged combat, coupled with a unique locomotion system perfectly attuned to your fighting style.

games.name: 爬行实验室
games.short_description: 获取弹药并升级你的枪来击败爬行女王的爪牙。 逃离实验室。

games.name: Zombie Shooter
games.short_description: The human race is in danger again. This time scientists could not cope the imminent threat and became monsters themselves. Crowds of zombie people filled the secret research base. The dreadful contagion is about to spread earth wide. Use the last chance to save the humanity from total annihilation!

games.name: 动物排球社
games.short_description: 《动物排球社》是一款策略性十足的回合制游戏，立足奇幻宇宙，结合排球与躲避球，带来别样体验。速速升级球员，在高强度Roguelike竞赛中战胜对手！

games.name: DUNGEONS OF CHAOS
games.short_description: Retro turn-based 2D pixelart RPG. Exploration, character choices, riddles and challenges. 80+ hours of gameplay.

games.name: Just Get Through
games.short_description: Just Get Through is a randomly generated platformer with roguelike elements. Featuring a destructible environment, sandbox mode, user-created levels, various gamemodes, hardcore mode, color palettes, deadly traps, explosions and more.

games.name: Erannorth Reborn
games.short_description: Erannorth Reborn is a hardcore sandbox Card Game with heavy emphasis on Deck-Building, Character Customization and Moddability. Create unique characters with distinctive attributes, racial/class skills and perks that affect your cards. Adjust and adapt your deck & equipment on-the-fly.

games.name: Enemy
games.short_description: The video games you played as a kid, mashed together and remade into a tactical role-playing game.

games.name: 伽尔兰特：我的冒险故事
games.short_description: 我是一名刚刚从学院毕业的猎鹰者。为了追求挑战而来到了遥远的王国边境：多伊地区的伽尔兰特镇。我将在这里书写我人生的新篇章，那必将是一段精彩绝伦的冒险故事。

games.name: Broken Armor
games.short_description: A knight exiled from his kingdom must find the holy grail if he is to return.

games.name: Iron Fisticle
games.short_description: A modern take on the classic arcade arena shooter. Taking inspiration from an entire generation of action games, Iron Fisticle builds on classic titles like Gauntlet and Robotron while adding over 100 collectible items, an RPG style upgrade system and local multiplayer.

games.name: 江城大赢家
games.short_description: 未来世界，金融体系轰然崩塌，旧有的秩序荡然无存。【彩票】成为生活物资的来源，【幸运】更是唯一的财富。你，作为一无所有的打工人，在这个命运天定的世界中，能否凭借勇气与智慧，靠着天降的【幸运系统】，从默默无闻的底层登上令人艳羡的财富之巅？

games.name: Super Mutant Alien Assault
games.short_description: 與死神共舞！在這款殘酷刺激的街機平臺射擊遊戲中，隨機進入房間，利用各種各樣的可解鎖武器、炸藥、特殊技能和防禦技巧，將入侵你的太空貨船的變種外星怪物趕盡殺絕。

games.name: 绝命游歌
games.short_description: Roguelite类节奏割草游戏。你需要扮演马超，在战斗中升级武器，组合羁绊，突破重围，杀出一条血路，就算被世界诅咒，也要手刃杀父仇人曹操！

games.name: Haque
games.short_description: Haque is a glitch fantasy roguelike adventure about cute monsters, low-bit hauntings, and a suspiciously talkative narrator. Choose your character and battle through forests, deserts and dungeons to defeat a mysterious evil. Die often. Try again!

games.name: 回渊迷城
games.short_description: 《回渊迷城》是一款策略类 rogue-lite 游戏，玩家需要在有限的时间中，透过组合不同的遗物和技能培育队伍，挑战强大而狡猾的怪物。在地下城最深处中等待冒险者的会是稀绝的宝藏，还是另一个绝望的开端......？

games.name: Deep Among the Swarm
games.short_description: Deep Among the Swarm is a challenging survival RTS roguelite about surviving against thousands of enemies. Drill ever deeper underground while fighting the endless onslaught of the Swarm. Can you save humanity?

games.name: 外星殖民公司
games.short_description: 带领你的员工，探索并占领一颗颗未知的星球吧！在回合制对决中，组建强大的牌组，灵活部署你的员工，使用公司新研发的究极武器，智胜外星人，掠夺珍贵宇宙资源。不断扩张成为外星殖民公司的年度最佳团队！

games.name: 诡秘射手
games.short_description: 《诡秘射手》 是一款节奏明快的轻量级Rogue-like特技射击游戏。穿越未知的克苏鲁世界 在变幻莫测的道路上求生。海量升级装备组合供你挑选，助你在挑战多阶段首领，与可怕怪物战斗时，逃出生天。

games.name: Cargo Commander
games.short_description: Alone in space, light years away from your family, armed with only your Fistcannon™; you are Cargo Corps' latest recruit, a Cargo Commander.

games.name: Beat Hazard 3
games.short_description: 准备好以探索美妙银河的方式来探索你自己的音乐收藏了吗？以前所未有的方式在这款双摇杆式的音乐节奏射击游戏中来体验你自己的音乐合集。你的每一首歌曲都有自己独特的韵律。

games.name: Girlfriend Rescue
games.short_description: Girlfriend Rescue is a thrilling adventure where the gameplay of "Dragon Quest" meets the atmosphere of "Streets of Rage". Innovative, mixing rogue-style RPG and Beat'em Up atmosphere in a unique way, this game features a great deal of strategy through a mix of character selection & creative skills.

games.name: 阿斯加德的陨落
games.short_description: 在《Asgard's Fall》中踏上史诗传奇之旅，体验北欧神话版的幸存者类Roguelite游戏。击退一波波的怪物大军，让诸神感受你的无情怒火。你的传奇之旅如何展开？

games.name: 超光速计划
games.short_description: 一款融合了Roguelite元素、极其逼真的跑轰动作射击游戏！与主角西格玛一起穿越时间线，阻止这场智械危机，为未来而战！

games.name: FISH FEAR ME
games.short_description: A top-down action roguelite about catching fish, fighting them, selling their bones, and catching more fish. Upgrade your boat and weapons, hunt down sea monster bounties, delve into eldritch mysteries, and try to pay off a cosmic debt millennia in the making.

games.name: You Must Build A Boat
games.short_description: 你必须造一艘船》是一款穿行于地下城的消除游戏。你将游历各个地下城，消除方块，与怪物作战。

games.name: The Adventurers
games.short_description: 《冒险者》是一款回合制战术角色扮演游戏，你的每个决定都会影响你的传奇。带领你的英雄小队，在充满随机事件的开放世界中前行，这些事件将影响你的故事。在奇幻的世界中生存，你的史诗传奇即将书写。

games.name: 幻影深渊
games.short_description: 《幻影深渊》是一款大型多人异步游戏，玩家将身处次序生成的神庙中，在险象环生的殿堂间寻找遗失的圣物。

games.name: 轮回的瓦尔基里
games.short_description: 在《轮回的瓦尔基里》中，驾驶你的飞船穿梭于无垠宇宙，迎战无尽敌军，收集和升级装备，追寻史诗级战利品，精进你的技能，掌握强大天赋。在与邪恶势力的斗争中，你将不断成长，变得更强大，直到能够扭转命运，拯救世界！

games.name: 幻想曹操传2
games.short_description: 打牌不如人妻好玩—— 鬼畜王曹操的轮回霸业。

games.name: 兰若异谭
games.short_description: 《兰若异谭》是一款以浓厚中国风的策略卡牌构筑和剧情探索为核心的Roguelike单机游戏。 通过战斗和探索的方式来了解这个浪漫诡谲的神秘世界，结识“兰若镇”上的人鬼精怪，与他们共同经历未知与抉择。

games.name: Summum Aeterna
games.short_description: Summum Aeterna is a fast-paced Roguelite inspired by the Metroidvania Aeterna Noctis. Create your own worlds, challenges, difficulty and influences in each new run. Die, learn, become stronger, and achieve victory. Death is inevitable, but glory is only for the chosen.

games.name: 神州志西游
games.short_description: 《神州志西游》是一款融合了RPG元素的Roguelike卡牌策略游戏。你需要组成强大的团队，构筑契合角色特点的牌组，收集各种耳熟能详的法宝和消耗品，一路挑战传说中的神魔鬼怪，去决定神州的最终命运。

games.name: Arcanium: Rise of Akhan
games.short_description: Arcanium is an Open-world, Strategy Card Adventure that merges Roguelite and Deckbuilding genres like never before. Control your party of three heroes, craft your deck, unlock a vast amount of cards and items and save the world of Arzu from corruption!

games.name: Good Robot
games.short_description: Good Robot is a fast-paced roguelike shoot-em-up that pits you against thousands of robots out to violate your warranty. Explore a procedurally generated sci-fi metropolis and the depths of corporate depravity, but never stop shooting...unless, of course, you're a Bad Robot. You're not, are you?

games.name: Half-Earth Socialism
games.short_description: Try your hand as a global planner of a future society. Play with a wide range of technologies and policies spanning different fields and ideologies. Will you lead the world to ecological utopia or planetary ruin?

games.name: Drop Pockets
games.short_description: 台球 Roguelike。 基于物理的战略战斗，对抗不遵守规则的台球鲨鱼。在这场混乱的台球游戏中，将你的球落袋并清除对手！

games.name: Siralim
games.short_description: 《Siralim》是一款带着轻度roguelike元素的深度角色扮演类游戏，你可以召唤并定制数百种生物来进行一场充满策略性的战斗。放手一战，在随机生成的地下城世界中去完成那些随机生成的任务吧。

games.name: Jet Kave Adventure
games.short_description: Jetpack through the prehistoric world in this Stone-Fiction adventure platformer. Enjoy challenging boss fights, flying over pitfalls, smashing through walls, knocking out enemies, and manipulating objects as you halt the alien threat once and for all.

games.name: NETHER DUNGEONS
games.short_description: Nether Dungeons is an action-packed dungeon crawler. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons, face relentless enemies, and defeat epic bosses. Customize your hero, wield diverse weapons, and survive intense challenges as you descend into ever-changing, dangerous depths.

games.name: Sentimental K
games.short_description: 《Sentimental K》是一款由神秘美少女K主演的3D动作冒险Roguelike游戏。游戏中，每次冒险都会随机生成武器、技能、遗物、地牢和首领，玩家需要根据这些随机元素找到最佳的协同策略，享受意想不到的挑战与乐趣！

games.name: Last Group Out
games.short_description: Team up, gear up, and make it out alive in this 2D co-op extraction shooter.

games.name: 玩个Gui
games.short_description: 这是一款塔防与Roguelike元素相结合的策略游戏。与传统塔防不同的是，游戏里的塔是会沿着轨道移动的战车，玩家需要规划防守回路，组建战斗列车来抵御敌人的攻击。

games.name: バレットフィリア達の闇市場　〜 100th Black Market.
games.short_description: 東方Project第18.5弾。上海アリス幻樂団による弾幕シューティング！ 市場は２種類あった？　魔理沙が闇市場の調査（＆カード蒐集）に大奮闘！ アビリティカードを駆使して遊ぶ、ハイスピードでブラックなシューティング幻想！

games.name: The Rangers In The South
games.short_description: 在这个2.5D像素风格的RogueLike ARPG中净化土地！创建数百个具有独特策略和技能的角色，面对成群的敌人，探索不同的生物群落、程序生成的地下城，并获得独特的物品！

games.name: Roguelands
games.short_description: Embark on an epic journey in this hardcore Multiplayer RPG! As a Galactic Cadet, you and your Combat Squad of friends must brave hostile worlds in search of valuable loot and resources. Craft powerful gear, slay otherworldly creatures, and save the galaxy.

games.name: Endhall
games.short_description: Endhall is a byte-sized roguelike. Become an artificial intelligence and combine tactical actions to defeat your enemies and reach the end of the hallway.

games.name: 狂飙之路：卡牌竞逐
games.short_description: 这是一款让人着迷的卡牌构筑汽车战斗Roadlike游戏。是的！Roadlike！出发！驾驶汽车在狂野的道路上横冲直撞！每场比赛只能有一个赢家！干掉你在路上看到的每一位对手，拆掉他们的车，让他们的零件成为你车上与众不同的战利品！同名桌游已众筹超过百万元！

games.name: 海山：昆仑镜
games.short_description: 扮演一位神秘剑客，使用20把形态各异的宝剑和90多种绚丽剑招。穿梭不同的时空，修炼功法和收集法宝，击败从封印中逃脱至人间的邪祟妖魔。

games.name: Neon Sundown
games.short_description: Neon Sundown is an extremely challenging arena-shooter that mixes fast-paced action with roguelite elements. Take on increasingly difficult arenas as you unlock new ships, upgrades, synergies, and more! Think you have what it takes to survive?

games.name: 骰子大改造
games.short_description: 《骰子大改造》是一款融合肉鸽元素的快艇骰子冒险游戏！积累足够分数即可闯入下一关卡，通过定制专属骰面可提升得分能力，还能收集圣物触发无限连击！在回合中赚取金币，购买全新骰子、传奇圣物与定制道具，不断升级你的骰组配置。每次开局都是全新的博弈体验！

games.name: 狩猎之夜：主权辛迪加
games.short_description: 来进行一场维多利亚时代的奇幻冒险吧！在这款牌组构筑游戏中，你将利用数百张独特卡牌打造数千种战术体系，挑战因瘟疫变异的怪物与强大头目，完成一个个毛骨悚然的任务，收集资源，调整策略，不断强化己身，在危机中逐步拨开层层迷雾，揭开隐藏的真相。

games.name: Our Darker Purpose
games.short_description: Journey to the dark heart of the Edgewood Home for Lost Children in this fiendishly difficult action RPG!When her teacher stepped out of the classroom a month ago, Cordy never imagined he would be gone for good. Now her fellow students have turned on each other as the school descends into chaos.

games.name: Devious Dungeon
games.short_description: Set in the Dark Ages, Devious Dungeon is a medieval focused action platformer with RPG styled upgrades.

games.name: METAL DOGS
games.short_description: 以人类毁灭后的世界为背景，战斗犬“波奇”的严酷战斗开始了。 探索每次进入都会发生变化的迷宫，获得各种武器并强化您的爱犬！ 追捕凶残的“WANTED”！在这款射击动作游戏中，您可以轻松享受令人振奋的战斗。

games.name: Monster Tiles TD: Tower Wars
games.short_description: Free Tower Defense game with unique roguelike elements. Custom base building mechanics allow you to create your own base and maze with tiles earned after each wave. Unleash a variety of monsters, each with its own evolution path and unique skills, and evolve them into legendary creatures.

games.name: 奇果工坊 (Idle Colony)
games.short_description: 在此放置游戏中，玩家将建立殖民地以收集并合并尺寸越来越大的水果。 通过改变游戏的科技和特殊升级，找到最佳协同策略，赚个盆满钵满。

games.name: 英雄征集
games.short_description: 《英雄征集》带您沉浸于无限可能的卡牌构筑世界。上百种英雄和道具，配合元素和技能，释放出强大的协同效应。简单、有趣、上瘾！无论你是Rougelike的新人还是老手，英雄们等待着你的征召，对最强魔王打出致命一击。

games.name: Into the Restless Ruins
games.short_description: 一款卡牌构筑类 roguelike 游戏，你将亲自打造战斗的地牢。每一夜，利用牌组扩展遗迹迷宫，借助自动战斗闯荡其中，收获光辉，赢得女神的祝福——这一切灵感源自苏格兰的民间传说、神话与传奇。

games.name: 血夜再临
games.short_description: Few Nights More 是一款rougelike回合制RPG游戏，在游戏中，吸血鬼领主试图征服丢失的领土，并在世界上称霸一方。设计并保卫你的据点，用陷阱杀死你的敌人，发挥领主的真正潜能，逐步征服属于你的一切

games.name: 小虎传：大菠萝深渊
games.short_description: 随机生成十八层大深渊，随缘结识各种队伍伙伴，白绿蓝紫的装备和技能获取也完全看脸。然而！大量随机的不确定性背后，其实是时刻在考验你临机应变、灵活安排的技巧。欧皇一手好牌可能打得稀烂，非酋单靠实力也能逆袭通关。一切未知，等待你的探索。

games.name: 3 Minute Heroes
games.short_description: 3分英雄是将塔类防守、卡牌构筑以及随机角色扮演类型结合为一体的实时战略游戏。放置英雄，使用卡牌，并安全保卫房屋3分钟！

games.name: Champions of Breakfast
games.short_description: A fast-paced arcade shooter breakfast-hell.

games.name: AIRHEART - Tales of broken Wings
games.short_description: Airheart是一款柴油朋克飞机动作游戏，每一层彩色天空都建立在前一层之上，一直延伸到平流层。 欢迎光临在云中穿行的城市Granaria。Meet Amelia - 飞行员兼渔妇，希望到达物产丰富的世界尽头。随着海盗肆虐，飞行捕鱼成为一项非常危险的工作。所以启动引擎、武装飞机，准备捕捞一生的收获！ Airheart将免费漫游、双摇杆游戏手柄玩法与美丽的彩色世界融为一体。打败敌人，打捞并重新利用他们的残骸为你的飞机制造新零件。制造和尝试40多种武器和飞机零件。以最佳方式组合它们，让你成为海盗最可怕的噩梦。或者只是戏弄敌人，并使用鱼叉解除他们的武装，把他们从藏身之处赶出来，晃动他们的飞机或拖回家中拆掉。

games.name: 机甲武装
games.short_description: 在这款后末世风格的回合制战略类Rogue游戏中，创造并指挥自定义机甲战胜怪物。利用地形，学习每台机甲的独特技能，利用战略和资源在不断变化的战斗中存活下来，给人类带来希望。

games.name: 👑选王之剑：零👑
games.short_description: 一款集成桌面跑团、经营策略、放置养成、轻度Rogue、角色构筑、战术回合制、二次元抽卡乐趣并取得平衡的游戏。同时也是由一名玩家“绝汪”打造的，纯粹的独立游戏。将向您展现我能拿出的所有智慧、幻想、诚意。收集力量，建立后宫，成为王者——

games.name: Chess Survivors
games.short_description: 《象棋幸存者》是一款基于网格的快速回合制 Roguelike 游戏，你需要智胜并消灭不断壮大的象棋敌人大军。结合技能、升级和遗物，打造出颠覆游戏格局的构筑。快速思考，死亡，学习，循环往复！

games.name: 魔域地牢 DungeonTop
games.short_description: 《魔域地牢》是一款融合了战棋布阵策略的Rogue-like桌面构建卡牌游戏，在这款游戏里你不止要面对牌组的构建，每回合棋盘的布阵同样重要。你可以选择不同的英雄和随从，挑战随机生成的地牢，像操纵棋子一样进行对战，击败各式各样的怪物和BOSS，解锁更多卡牌。

games.name: 净化之径
games.short_description: 当恶魔是一个可爱的小姑娘的时候，你还会对它敬而远之么？”面对越来越艰难的战斗，操作魔神在关卡内净化被圣灵腐蚀的“人类”，面对天使的刁难，看看你能走多远……

games.name: Don't Lose Aggro
games.short_description: 在这款受MMO副本启发的单人动作roguelite中，通过迫使敌人攻击你来保护队伍！创建独特流派，解锁强大天赋，掌握坦克艺术，掌控混乱战场！

games.name: Tower of Guns
games.short_description: Tower of Guns is a fast paced first-person-shooter for the twitch gamer... with a few randomized elements to keep it fresh with each playthrough. It's a short burst "Lunch Break FPS"... not unlike Binding of Isaac mixed with Doom 2. Tower of Guns was made by a guy named Joe (with his brother Mike composing the music).

games.name: Delivery from the Pain:Survival / 末日方舟:生存
games.short_description: 您将扮演一个幸存者，身处被僵尸肆虐的世界里。在这个危机四伏的环境中，您将需要不断探索，与其他幸存者互动并做出选择：帮助他们还是利用他们？在与僵尸战斗的同时，您还需要收集资源、学习制造、并强化自己的庇护所。最终，您需要运用自己的智慧和策略，找到逃脱这个世界的方法，重新回到人类的安全之地。

games.name: The Black Pool
games.short_description: 在城外的森林里，四个朋友发现了一个神秘的黑色池塘，这个黑池将他们带入一个未知世界。为了回家，他们必须解锁并掌握各种超自然能力。这款高节奏动作游戏允许你独自探险或与朋友并肩作战，每一局游戏都充满了独特的挑战和技巧。

games.name: Symbiotic
games.short_description: Symbiotic is a fast-paced, first-person roguelike shooter where you, an escaped prisoner, stole a real monster of a weapon: The Symbiote. Fight with an evolving weapon and escape!

games.name: Asteroids ++
games.short_description: Asteroids ++ is the best Asteroids game you will ever play in your life. Customize your spaceship with your weapon loadout, save your solar system, and destroy those damn Asteroids! And remember, you can never end Asteroid genocide!

games.name: 灵能哨卫：无限
games.short_description: 灵能哨卫:无限【官方 QQ 群：180764247】 "灵能哨卫:无限"是一款第三人称的美少女动作射击Rougelike， 爽快但任何玩家都能上手的反击系统是游戏操作的核心， 在战斗中观察敌人的弱点将其破除则是游戏策略的重点。

games.name: 血牌
games.short_description: 《Blood Card》是一款结合了Roguelike元素的卡牌游戏。你需要不断前进，打造独一无二的卡组，击败阻挡你的敌人，逃离或击败试图夺走你生命的死神。

games.name: Revenge of the Mage
games.short_description: RotM 是一款动作类 Roguelite FPS 游戏，玩家将化身为一名法师。让命运之手为你的魔法力量开辟道路！拯救多元宇宙，增强自身实力！解锁、收集、探索、生存、死亡、重复

games.name: 烛火地牢2：猫咪的诅咒
games.short_description: 欢迎来到Tallowmere小姐的地牢！《烛火地牢2：猫咪的诅咒》是一款将Roguelike与2D横板动作的特点融为一体的独立游戏。玩家每一次游玩都会随机生成新的房间布局，在杀戮与死亡的反复轮回中探索这座地牢。

games.name: Domestic Dog
games.short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a dog? Well now you can, kinda...

games.name: Road Defense: Outsiders
games.short_description: 保护道路上的战车，让他们生存下去！道路防御：外来人是一款结合了 "roguelike （一类游戏的统称）"和 "塔防 "类型的游戏。升级塔楼和你自己的技能，以便能够歼灭你周围的所有敌人!

games.name: 自走骑士团
games.short_description: 《自走骑士团》是一款创新PVP自走棋竞技游戏！在3x3的微型战场中，您将招募拥有独特技能的像素骑士，通过智慧布局与角色升级打造无敌阵容，找到属于自己的战术流派！记住，每场战斗都是千变万化的策略考验！快来加入这场策略博弈的盛宴！

games.name: Spacelines from the Far Out: Flight School
games.short_description: 来自远方的空间线。飞行学校的目的是让你在发射前做好准备，承担起经营自己的空间线的任务! 与其他3人一起接受挑战和要求，将人们运送到他们的目的地。

games.name: Chrysalis
games.short_description: Defend your Chrysalis from growing hordes of monsters in this hybrid game that combines elements of tower defense, survival, and roguelike RPGs. Explore procedurally generated levels, possess and control animals, and grow deadly gardens. How far can you get before the next wave of monsters?

games.name: 异常情绪回收组
games.short_description: 异常情绪回收组是一款类rogue回合制游戏。你能在这里遇到各种奇奇怪怪规则的情绪体，这些情绪体的效果都是一团谜，只有不断去解析未知效果的情绪体，不断用生命去积累经验，才能按照它的规则去利用它，获取非常强大的效果。

games.name: Pixel Descent
games.short_description: Pixel Descent is an action rogue-lite in which you navigate a series of complex dungeons packed to the brim with monsters that want you dead. Sign the contract and descend into the deepest depths of the abyss knowing full well that you will definitely die there, it's just a matter of when.

games.name: 白夜星魂 Souls of White Star
games.short_description: 《白夜星魂》是一款回合制卡牌+战棋策略的太空科幻游戏。创新的游戏机制和丰富的剧情内容将会带给你别样的乐趣。游戏支持创意工坊。

games.name: 破晓战纪
games.short_description: 一款以建造与防守为核心的轻Rogue策略游戏。玩家通过建设领地，招募士兵来抵御敌人的进攻。游戏包含9张关卡地图、6把拥有30种天赋的武器、40种怪物以及30种可建造的单位与建筑。通过合理规划建造节奏、操控士兵、选择能力来灵活应对不同的敌人，享受指挥与策略交织的乐趣。

games.name: The Druid
games.short_description: We embody the spirit of The Dagda, king of the Celtic gods, with the objective of liberating his territory from the corruption of the goddess Morrigan in a 2D roguelike platformer full of intensity.

games.name: Vertical Drop Heroes HD
games.short_description: Vertical Drop Heroes is a procedural platformer RPG hybrid with roguelike elements, where your hero adventures through randomly generated stages. Armed with a variety of skills and traits, you must use your cunning and reflexes to survive the dangers of each stage.

games.name: VOLTED
games.short_description: 坦克，飞行汽车，巨型昆虫，大量枪支，子弹雨 - 就是这么疯狂！ PS：别忘了带上你的朋友。

games.name: Sea of Survivors
games.short_description: 在《幸存者之海》中，你可以扬帆把舵驶向各方，但永远不能停下脚步。避开和消灭成群的海盗和海怪，获取经验值，提升等级，为船只选择升级项。探索神秘诅咒，解锁独特宝藏，为生存而战。

games.name: Deliverance & Reign
games.short_description: 邪恶的哥特城堡门前，正义与邪恶将迎来最终的决战。在这个卡牌构建roguelike中，你可以自由选择阵营，加入正义之师，勇闯魔窟；抑或是化身为魔头艾拉瑞克本尊，守护自己的城堡，完成这最后的献祭仪式！

games.name: Gemini
games.short_description: Gemini is an action tower defense game, where your goal is to protect the crystal and stay alive.

games.name: 公主：东方与远征（Princess: The East and the Expedition）
games.short_description: 中探花之后，皇帝钦命你为远征将军。在远征过程中，你可以选择交好或攻略等不同手段扩张国土，体验不同国家的人文风貌并开启与不同风貌NPC之间的爱恨情仇~ 快来开辟属于你的专属领土吧！！！已经购买过勾八公主狂想曲的玩家无需购买公主：东方与远征

games.name: 超级猫幸存者
games.short_description: 喵！这是一款猫咪主题的类幸存者游戏，你将控制一只可爱的超级猫，打怪升级，收集道具，强化武器，研究策略搭配，与入侵喵星的怪物作战，体验畅快刺激的战斗，守卫喵星！而随着战斗的深入，通过成就挑战可以解锁新角色和新道具，超级猫们将变得更加强大！

games.name: 开炮吧方舟 Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship
games.short_description: 建造炮塔，升级战舰，营救船员，探索未知，打造属于你自己战斗风格的末日孤舰，纵横战场！

games.name: 奇幻东征
games.short_description: 《奇幻东征》是一款Roguelike的冒险动作游戏，玩家扮演受天神诏示而踏上征途的领导者。在随机的地图与路线上做出抉择、招兵买马、搜集宝物、通过各种战斗和奇遇来完成使命！

games.name: 道无穷
games.short_description: 《道无穷》是一款修仙背景，可高难度挑战的肉鸽游戏。玩家从练气期开始修行，提升境界，探寻功法、服用丹药、构筑强大的法宝组合，击败成千上万的妖兽，修得大道圆满。

games.name: Citywars Tower Defense
games.short_description: Citywars TD 是一款可爱的多人第三人称生存塔防。 建造塔楼，收集资源，制作工具，升级武器，升级建筑物，与朋友一起扩展你的城市，并在下一波怪物到来之前在压力下工作。

games.name: Unemployment Simulator 2018
games.short_description: 基于真实事件的社会福利生存恐怖游戏。忍受情感痛苦与社会压力。保持自我娱乐。挺过日复一日的循环，成为你单身公寓的英雄——与内心的恶魔搏斗，把骷髅藏进衣柜里，最重要的是……保持浴室整洁。

games.name: 重返深渊
games.short_description: 《重返深渊》是一款带有Rogue-Lite元素的割草生存游戏，升级武器并运用你的战斗技巧，在同屏超过10000只怪物中杀出重围，直至击败制造混乱的罪魁祸首为止！

games.name: Flotilla
games.short_description: Lead your orbital battleships to victory in Flotilla! Fight, trade, and explore new planets in your journey through the galaxy. Featuring tactically rich 3D combat, flank and surprise the enemy from any direction. When the dust settles, generate another randomized universe for a brand new adventure!

games.name: OmniFootman
games.short_description: 全职小兵OmniFootman是一款Rogue-Lite，Souls-Like的动作冒险游戏。你将面对一个被诅咒，充满敌意而变幻无常的王国，有效地利用好获得的装备和能力，存活下来并且战胜对手。注意，你将面对永久死亡惩罚。

games.name: Bullet Bunny
games.short_description: Bullet Bunny is a twin-stick shooter with rogue-like elements. Fend off an onslaught of enemies, level up, and create unique builds every run while trying to survive 500 seconds!

games.name: 战争框架
games.short_description: 《战争框架》是一款动作肉鸽类游戏。在游戏中玩家会面对无情、无尽的外星人大军。为此需要收集资源、购买机甲和武器，构建自己的机甲中队！注意各种机甲之间协同作用，还有武器与机甲的升级和组合。

games.name: 超级子弹娘
games.short_description: 在这款组牌策略型的轻Rogue游戏中，你需要从一个邪恶的人工智能手中拯救游戏世界，解除各个网络游戏的危机！探索各种经典游戏品类的地图，挑战高难度的回合制战斗，深入敌营，收集超过160枚可爱又迷人的子弹娘。

games.name: Idle Dice 2
games.short_description: Roll Dice, Draw Cards, Get Points

games.name: 打倒白雪公主！乌拉！
games.short_description: 站起来吧，受压迫的小矮人们，挥动你们手中的武器，反抗来自邪恶统治者白雪公主的压迫。但革命的征途绝非一帆风顺，每前进一步都要提防敌人的进攻。而你，需要领导小矮人联盟，派出强大的阵容，合理构筑卡牌来最大化你的优势，要坚信，自由铸成的联盟牢不可破！

games.name: Fabled Lands
games.short_description: Fabled Lands is a challenging old-school narrative RPG set in an open world. Complete quests, fight, trade goods and develop your character. Explore a vast land of adventure: travel across the war-torn kingdom, survive the plains of howling darkness, and escape the Court of Hidden Faces.

games.name: 次元奇兵
games.short_description: 次元奇兵是一款美漫画风Roguelike卡牌构筑游戏，游戏内有20+位次元战士可以召集与培养。组建一支3人小队，从100+独特技能中精挑细选，组合技能打出疯狂的Combo。多元宇宙，等你拯救！

games.name: Cyclo Chambers
games.short_description: 通过收集可联动能力模块,构建强力的角色以抵御成群的独眼巨人. 《Cyclo Chambers》是一款快节奏,自顶至下的竞技射击游戏,并附带有轻度Rouge元素.多达150种能力模块可供选择,奇思妙想的Build为每一局游戏都带来不一样的体验.

games.name: 最后的防线
games.short_description: 《最后的防线》是一款塔防主题的类Rouge游戏。玩家需要通过建设基地、搭配天赋以及对战时的精细操作来抵御一波又一波的敌人。在战斗过程中，如何合理使用地形、如何分配有限的资源、如何选择兵种以及如何搭配天赋从而能够发挥出最大的战斗力，这些都将是对玩家的考验。记住，你的每一次选择都将影响最后的战局！

games.name: 打倒白雪公主！乌拉！：序章
games.short_description: 进入《打倒白雪公主！乌拉！》带领经典童话故事中的小矮人们团结起来，建立牢不可破的联盟。在这款拥有丰富故事情节的肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏中，反抗邪恶的白雪公主！（全面支持简体中文！）

games.name: Doomed to Hell
games.short_description: Doomed to Hell is a roguelike-like top-down shooter where you play as Rose, a human in hell who will need to fight all of its monsters in waves of enemies, defeat bosses, and get new weapons to earn back his life on earth.

games.name: 死而符生
games.short_description: 《死而符生》是一款将老虎机玩法和牌组构建相结合的Roguelite游戏。在这片被绝望侵蚀的大地上，你将持有多本符文秘典，操纵符文匹配连接以击败敌人。搭配好各类遗物，用惊天动地的大数字碾碎那些腐朽的黑暗爪牙。

games.name: 节奏快打
games.short_description: 这是一款跟随节奏进行战斗的Roguelike横版动作游戏！节奏激斗，拳拳到肉~蹦迪打怪，砍瓜切菜！

games.name: Star Story: The Horizon Escape
games.short_description: 你将带着全息私人助理，驾驶着自己的宇宙飞船去完成探索神秘的天际星球的任务！会出什么错呢？一切都可能出错！这是一个有着文字角色扮演类元素的回合制冒险游戏。

games.name: Sproggiwood
games.short_description: Bring civilization to Sproggiwood, a story-driven, turn-based roguelike set in a humorous world inspired by Finnish mythology. Grow your civilization and plunder procedural dungeons with six unique classes. Outsmart mischievous monsters who work together in unexpected ways. No two dungeon dives are alike.

games.name: 雾方福地 - Into the Emberlands
games.short_description: 走入光烬之地，探索千变万化永不停歇的世界。这里充满了让人啧啧称奇的邂逅与神秘生物！拯救迷失在瘴气中的村民，收集资源并重建村庄，为族人打造一处安全的避风港。

games.name: Shoulders of Giants: Ultimate
games.short_description: 在《巨人之肩》中同时控制挥舞剑的机甲和开枪的太空青蛙，这是一款爆炸性多彩的科幻迷宫冒险游戏。可以独自游玩，与朋友一同，或作为四人团队的一部分，穿越敌人的攻势，拯救银河，抵御熵之力量！

games.name: 西游幸存者
